chapters.title: Chapter 570: Breaking the Curse [Bonus]
paragraphs: Kent learned from Elaine’s father that they were once a family of powerful Life magicians. Long before the battle of parting, the Wynthrall rose to the peak of this world, producing many immortals.
Back then, one could rise to the ranks of Heavenly Ascension, and after calling down the heavenly tribulation, they could ascend to the Immortal worlds.
There were no High worlds or Medium worlds back then.
However, once one reached the limit, which was at the Heavenly Ascension stage (the peak in a high world now), they would ascend using tribulations or an ascension stone.
The Wynthrall family produced many geniuses who were sent away to enrich the family name in the immortal worlds.
They were bigger and more powerful, even bigger than the most powerful sects. However, that all came down within the blink of an eye.

When the war that separated the races and placed limits on the world descended, they lost everything. Their bloodline was cursed, and from what Kent learned, this curse was a Tier 15 spell that even affected the Elves.
By estimation, the spell came from the Dark Region. However, nobody dares go there simply because nobody wants to know what is hidden there.
Just like how nobody dares enter the Dead Region in the ancient battlefield of parting, nobody wants to enter the Dark Region, too.

However, the same curse that brought down an entire family and perhaps an entire race was now being broken, and the one doing that was the inexperienced Formation Master who had now miraculously gained the means to draw thousands of runes within minutes.
Kent could just smile and stand there watching as thousands of runes joined the ones already in the air.
"I don’t understand something. If the spell is still active, how can you break the curse on her?" Kent asked, thinking about the Tier 15 spell that was used to curse Elaine’s bloodline.
"More importantly, are you telling me you can write Tier 15 formations to break Tier 15 spells?" Vexthra also asked, and her sisters, except Unity, wanted both answers.
"What’s there to question? Sister Alina is awesome." Unity, of course, tried to hype her sister, which this time, her sister didn’t mind.
They wanted to know what Kent and Vexthra had asked about.

"No, I can’t write Tier 15 formations yet, but that doesn’t mean I can’t break the curse. And for the question on whether the curse can be broken without the main spell being destroyed, the answer is simple.
I am merely taking her out of the equation." Alina answered a whole lot of questions.
"How are you going to take her out of the equation?" Val asked.
"Also very simple. The formation I am creating contains two different arrays. One is called the Separation Array. It separates the curse from Elaine. Basically, I will be cloning the curse.
Then, once I do that, the second array, the Isolation Array, will completely isolate the curse from her, leaving her to enjoy her bloodline like the curse was never there.
And with the True Name on the way, I can already see something coming out of this."
"I don’t really understand anything she said. Big sister Vexthra, can you explain?" Val said, wanting to understand all Alina had said.
"It sounded simpler than it really is, but what she is doing is, as she said, very simple. She will separate the curse on Elaine’s bloodline using the same formation/array used for cloning.
Only this time, the clone will be the curse, and the main body will be Elaine with a perfect bloodline," Vexthra explained.
"However, I also have a question... Alina, what or where would you put the clone, which is the curse? I suppose destroying will be impossible unless, of course, I intervene."
Her sisters turned toward the beautiful Alina.
"I will put it inside the Celestial Portrait of the Eternal Garden. Something this powerful should not be destroyed; you never know when you will need it."
"This..."
Vexthra was puzzled.
The Celestial Portrait of the Eternal Garden is something immortals, gods, supremes, and even celestials want to glimpse at least once in their lifetime.
It contains profound teachings, people, events, and history that a single chance to glimpse will benefit anyone.
However, such a profound treasure is now being used as a vault to house a Tier 15 curse.
’This... if the Supreme Celestial hears this, he is going to be pissed. I can already see him going on a rampage.’
’I better make sure she never takes this out in public. If it belongs to her or once belonged to her, then she can create a new one. I am sure nobody will try to kill her for that.’
An hour passed, and Alina was still drawing the rune. Thankfully, she stopped and formed a seal after a few more minutes, bringing all the runes together to form one powerful rune.
"This is Tier 10... You are already a Formation King," Vexthra said, a little shocked.
"It’s all thanks to our man," Alina smiled, causing Kent’s head to grow big. But who could blame him? Being surrounded by dozens of beautiful women, each complimenting him.
Even a Saint would feel some pride in that.
"I am going to put this formation in you. Don’t worry, it is not painful, and will be over before you know it," Alina said, and Elaine nodded.
"Alright, you all can step back except Kent." Her sisters did, and Kent walked closer.
"What do you want me to do?" Kent asked.
"The moment the curse is out, I want you to cut its head off. And don’t ask. I want you instead of big sister Vexthra because your Eternal Body makes you immune to curses."
"I guess that is something new I am just learning about my new mutated body," Kent smiled and got ready.
Alina directed the formation rune and entered Elaine’s forehead.
The moment it did, a powerful energy burst out of her body, and with it was another copy of Elaine. However, this one had deep, dark eyes instead of the green ones on Elaine.
As Alina directed, Kent’s sword came and went like a flash. On the ground, however, was the severed head of the curse that appeared like a person wearing Elaine’s face but with a dark set of eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 571: Celestial Golden Jade Lotus
paragraphs: In a faraway place, somewhere even time seems to have forgotten, a large castle stood tall and strong despite the passing of time.
Its gates were closed shut, and looking at how vines latched onto and redecorated the walls, nobody needed to be told it had been shut for a long time.
In truth, this castle had been sealed for 25,000 years.
Nobody knew what was inside or what it represented. Perhaps many knew, but due to the passing of time, it eventually washed away from the minds of those who had a clue.
Taking a look inside, one could see everything was covered in large white cloths that looked worn out. It has been years after all.
Beyond that, a large altar was in the middle of the room with a dimly lit, glowing purple spell circle on it.
It appeared to have been glowing for a very long time.
Suddenly, this spell circle glowed brightly, and the purple light penetrated the castle’s glassy windows. The light traveled far beyond the castle’s borders, spreading thousands of miles away.
This light reached all corners of the realm, and in seven places scattered across the region, seven pillars lit up, shooting beams into the clouds.
Back to the castle, deep underground, inside what looked like a burial space, thousands of coffins could be seen shut in the darkness.
They all looked elegant, made using the finest jade and gold.

Suddenly, the lid on one of the coffins burst open, sending powerful dark energy everywhere. Inside was the worn-out body of a man whose eyes were closed. He looked dead; however, the next second after the lid burst off, he opened his eyes.
Then, in a chilling tone, he muttered some words...
"...Blood of a Wynthrall."
Suddenly, all lids started bursting open, revealing more worn-out, completely dried bodies. Strangely, beneath every last coffin that opened, there were pools of blood running like rivers.
Surrounding these rivers were even more coffins that eventually opened.
They all uttered the same words as the first...
"...Blood of a Wynthrall."
Far from this castle and the seven pillars, signals lit up on every last continent, signaling the awakening of something ancient that should never have awakened in this rather peaceful world.
Kent looked at the beheaded body of the cursed corpse disguised as Elaine and let out a deep sigh.
"Things never stop looking bizarre. It’s like there’s always something weirder after the last weird thing." His words made Alina laugh.
"...This is a cultivation world, so it’s only natural to see bizarre things like this." She pressed her hand against Elaine’s forehead for a few seconds before letting go.
Suddenly, a powerful burst of energy erupted from Elaine’s body.
"This..." The sudden turn of events took the life magician’s breath away.
"I am advancing in my life magic... this... the curse has been broken... hahaha." Her tears fell as she laughed, feeling overjoyed, yet her emotions overwhelmed her, making her shed tears of joy.

She went from Tier 4 to Tier 5. Then it moved to 6, and then stopped when it reached Tier 7. In the vast world of Life Magic, she could be considered a Life King, someone akin to a Pill King if she were an alchemist.
However, the sudden rise in her life magic wasn’t the only thing that happened to her. After the breakthroughs, a small lotus tattoo appeared on her forehead.
Suddenly, the manifestation green and golden lotus appeared behind her.
It appeared and enlarged until it was large enough to be seen thousands of miles away.
Vexthra, who was standing back, suddenly gasped, placing her hand over her mouth. Her sisters became puzzled watching such an expression.
However, before they could ask a question, three presences appeared in the Soul Tower. Naturally, it was the three lolis who wore shocked expressions on their faces, too.
⟪Is that the infamous Celestial Golden Jade Lotus...?⟫ Gaia asked, eyes wide. Clearly, something universe-shattering was happening that they couldn’t believe.
⟪I know my eyes won’t deceive me, so that is indeed the Celestial Golden Jade Lotus... the jade lotus that went missing billions of years ago. I can’t believe it.⟫
⟪Who would have thought that in a remote world, a place no immortal would dare step, has been housing the infamous innate body constitution that only appeared once in all of time this whole time?⟫
The words from the three lolis reached the ladies, giving them a fair idea of what was happening.

"As expected, anyone Kent adds to his harem is special. Sister Elaine is even more special than I expected." Unity, of course, had to hype Elaine, who sat with eyes closed, letting her awakening stabilize first.
"Big sister, can you tell us about what is happening?" Mara asked, looking in Elaine’s direction. Vexthra, who was asked this question, took a minute to compose himself and answered.
"There are some things that cannot be spoken about. They are things the laws won’t allow to be spoken of by just anyone.
The Celestial Golden Jade Lotus is one of such things. I can’t say much simply because the public knowledge I have is limited.
However, from what I know, the Celestial Golden Jade Lotus is a powerful innate body constitution that appeared during the primordial era.
They say it’s one that holds the power of life and death. The one who possesses it holds life and death at their fingertips."
Cough.
Vexthra suddenly coughed up blood, some coming from her nose, but she held a smile on her face.
"Big sister, are you okay?" Unity and her sisters panicked, watching this.
"Yes, I am fine," she said, but the three lolis shook their heads. They knew that if the one who said this were even a demigod, they would have died where they stood.
Some things are public knowledge, but that doesn’t mean they can be spoken about casually. The price paid for such offenses can sometimes amount to one’s life.
"Don’t talk again, Vex. You will only hurt yourself." Kent, who wore a panicked expression when he saw Vexthra bleeding, quickly cleaned her blood and warned her.
However, before Vexthra could answer, a green leaf designed with golden lines flew from Elaine’s forehead and landed in Vexthra’s hand.
"This..."
The three lolis held their jaws loose, not believing their eyes...

"I am advancing in my life magic... this... the curse has been broken... hahaha." Her tears fell as she laughed, feeling overjoyed, yet her emotions overwhelmed her, making her shed tears of joy.
She went from Tier 4 to Tier 5.
Then it moved to 6, and then stopped when it reached Tier 7.
In the vast world of Life Magic, she could be considered a Life King, someone akin to a Pill King if she were an alchemist.
However, the sudden rise in her life magic wasn’t the only thing that happened to her.
After the breakthroughs, a small lotus tattoo appeared on her forehead.
Suddenly, the manifestation green and golden lotus appeared behind her.
It appeared and enlarged until it was large enough to be seen thousands of miles away.
Vexthra, who was standing back, suddenly gasped, placing her hand over her mouth.
Her sisters became puzzled watching such an expression.
However, before they could ask a question, three presences appeared in the Soul Tower.
Naturally, it was the three lolis who wore shocked expressions on their faces, too.
⟪Is that the infamous Celestial Golden Jade Lotus...?⟫ Gaia asked, eyes wide.
Clearly, something universe-shattering was happening that they couldn’t believe.
⟪I know my eyes won’t deceive me, so that is indeed the Celestial Golden Jade Lotus... the jade lotus that went missing billions of years ago.
I can’t believe it.⟫
⟪Who would have thought that in a remote world, a place no immortal would dare step, has been housing the infamous innate body constitution that only appeared once in all of time this whole time?⟫
The words from the three lolis reached the ladies, giving them a fair idea of what was happening.
"As expected, anyone Kent adds to his harem is special.
Sister Elaine is even more special than I expected." Unity, of course, had to hype Elaine, who sat with eyes closed, letting her awakening stabilize first.
"Big sister, can you tell us about what is happening?" Mara asked, looking in Elaine’s direction.
Vexthra, who was asked this question, took a minute to compose himself and answered.
"There are some things that cannot be spoken about.
They are things the laws won’t allow to be spoken of by just anyone.
The Celestial Golden Jade Lotus is one of such things.
I can’t say much simply because the public knowledge I have is limited.
However, from what I know, the Celestial Golden Jade Lotus is a powerful innate body constitution that appeared during the primordial era.
They say it’s one that holds the power of life and death.
The one who possesses it holds life and death at their fingertips."
Cough.
Vexthra suddenly coughed up blood, some coming from her nose, but she held a smile on her face.
"Big sister, are you okay?" Unity and her sisters panicked, watching this.
"Yes, I am fine," she said, but the three lolis shook their heads.
They knew that if the one who said this were even a demigod, they would have died where they stood.
Some things are public knowledge, but that doesn’t mean they can be spoken about casually.
The price paid for such offenses can sometimes amount to one’s life.
"Don’t talk again, Vex.
You will only hurt yourself." Kent, who wore a panicked expression when he saw Vexthra bleeding, quickly cleaned her blood and warned her.
However, before Vexthra could answer, a green leaf designed with golden lines flew from Elaine’s forehead and landed in Vexthra’s hand.
"This..."
The three lolis held their jaws loose, not believing their eyes...

chapters.title: Chapter 572: Godly Paths, Hidden Memories
paragraphs: "This is..." Vexthra’s sisters looked at the green leaf in her palm and couldn’t help but ask.
"It is... a leaf from the Tree of Life," she answered, holding the leaf like a delicate egg. Not that it was far from that.
The leaf from the Tree of Life was something even a god like her was impressed and shocked by, to the point she couldn’t afford to put it in her mouth.
If another god saw her holding such a leaf, they would probably attack and try to take it from her. That’s how valuable the leaf from the tree of life is.
If Vexthra wanted, she could keep it and only use it when she truly needed it.
Too bad she had a worried husband.
Kent, who knew what the leaf was and what it did thanks to his enchanted eyes, picked it up and stuffed it into her mouth.

Unfortunately for Vexthra, the moment it entered her mouth, it dissolved into energy and entered her body. She immediately sat in lotus posture and started regulating the energy flowing through her body.
After a few minutes, she opened her eyes with a sigh and a smile.
"This is just too much... After millions of years since I became a True God, I have reached my first bottleneck, and it’s all thanks to Elaine, a mortal who is not even a Root Ascension expert yet."
Vexthra’s eyes were filled with warmth as she stared at Elaine.
"Does this mean you will leave soon to handle your bottleneck?" Unity asked in a sad tone.

"Not yet. I still have some of the energy from the Leaf of Life yet to be absorbed. But aside from that, I need to choose a path I must walk to become a Supreme. So until then, I will be here with you all."
The sisters smiled, hearing that. Of course, the ever-nerdy Voidling had to get curious, so she asked,
"Can you tell us the next phase after the True God stage?"
"I don’t mind." Vexthra was actually happy to say something about being a god. She didn’t have any friends to talk to until now.
"Once you become a True God, your divinity will be recognized by the Daos... you call them the laws of the heavens.
But they are actually Dao. The Dao has to recognise you first before you can face the True Good Realm tribulation and become a true god.
This True God realm is where your future will be determined. You see, after becoming a True God, there are two paths you can choose to become a Supreme being.
The first is the Ancient Path, where you create a god body and make it undergo the four Divine Tribulations.
The first trial, if passed, will make you a God Lord. The second will make you a God King. The third is a God Emperor, and the last is a God Monarch.
After this, you will merge with your god body and undergo the Supreme Tribulation to become an Early Supreme. It’s a long process that can take millions of years.
The second is a path known as the Dao Path. Once one chooses this path, they will become what we call an Outer God. This path looks and sounds simple; however, it’s actually very hard.
You must study 1,000 Daos and understand them to some degree, where you will gain the Dao Mark. The moment you gain that, you move to the next until you gain a thousand Dao Marks.
Once you gain all that, you must form your own Dao and fully comprehend it. It’s your Dao, so you must understand it fully. If it succeeds, the Supreme Tribulation will come."
"That sounds like a lot of work," Val said, not wanting to consider it.
"Indeed, it’s a lot of work. But since the beginning of time, this has been the only path to supremacy."
"Maybe someone should create a new path. I mean, undergoing four tribulations sounds like a suicide mission to me." Velyra couldn’t help but smile.
The ladies smiled with her. However, they quickly noticed Kent wasn’t talking. He stood there blankly as if he was trying to recall something.
"Kent... Kent... Kent—" Vexthra called three times before he was startled awake.
"Kent, is everything alright?" Vexthra asked with a concerned look. Her sister wore the same expression.
Kent smiled and cupped her cheeks. "I am fine. I just feel like I have forgotten something very important when you started talking about the god paths." His smile spread across her face.
"By the way, you should walk both paths. Walk both the path of the Dao and the Ancient Path." Vexthra’s jaw dropped hearing that.
"Why say that?" Neomi asked, knowing Kent wouldn’t joke about something this important.
"If you want to stand at the pinnacle in the future, then walk the path no one has walked before." His words made his ladies frown.
He just laughed and turned back to Elaine.
Meanwhile, the three Lolis appeared back inside the mountain garden holding the weak Dori, whose face was pale, like she had lost all the blood in her body.
Gaia and Akira wore concerned expressions.
⟪Dori, what happened? Why did you suddenly lose all your Cosmic energy? I can’t feel even a single strand of cosmic energy from you,⟫ Gaia asked.

⟪I also don’t know. Just now, when the beautiful goddess was talking, I felt the master’s mind split in two, and then, from the center, a memory that shouldn’t have existed—something I had no idea where it came from—started to surface.

If I hadn’t acted immediately and sealed it back, I am afraid things would have gone bad real quick. It’s a good thing I had enough energy to seal his mind back to its normal state,⟫ Dori explained, catching her breath.
⟪A forbidden memory. This is...⟫ Akira wasn’t even done when a voice entered their heads.
"Children, stop talking about it. And Gaia, cover for Doriana, I need to take her away to recover. Don’t worry, she will be back sooner than you think."
⟪Okay, mother.⟫ Gaia and Akira responded.
⟪Get well soon, Dori.⟫ They said their farewells, and Dori’s body turned to cosmic energy and vanished.
The two sisters stood there for a few minutes before Gaia sighed and created a copy of herself that looked like Dori.
⟪I can copy her looks but not her mind.⟫ Gaia sighed.

⟪Let’s just tell master she is working on something important so she can’t be disturbed. Since she is already done with the weave for the Primordial Chamber, her absence won’t be felt much,⟫ Akira proposed, and Gaia nodded, dispersing her clone.
⟪Let’s get busy then. Time to continue building.⟫
Like nothing had happened, the two cosmic lolis went back to work.
Meanwhile, Dori’s body reassembled at the universe’s core, where a wave of cosmic energy started entering her cosmic core.

chapters.title: Chapter 573: Elaine’s Powers Before True Name Awakening [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Huh, where are Gaia and her sisters?" Mara suddenly asked, noticing the three sisters’ absence.
"Maybe they had had enough and left," Lilian answered, but Kent felt something was weird, so he reached out to Gaia.
’Gaia, is everything alright? You three were here, and the next second, you were gone.’ Kent felt worried for a moment, but when he heard Gaia’s reply, a sigh escaped his mouth.
⟪We are fine, master. We just had enough and left to continue our projects.⟫
’Is Dori okay?’ For some reason, Kent felt like something wasn’t right about what had just happened, and since it had something to do with his memory, he had to ask about Dori.
She is basically his mind after all.
⟪She is fine, master. She is just busy with a project she is working on.⟫ Gaia responded.
"Okay, thank you," Kent smiled.
’Why is Gaia lying to me?’ A sigh escaped his lips, and then he chose to let it slide.
’They never lie to me, so if she did, it must be something she can’t talk about. I have to trust them and hope everything is okay.’
"How are they?" Vexthra asked, knowing Kent could telepathically speak with anyone inside the tower, regardless of who they were.
"They are fine. They just had enough, so they went back to work." In the end, Kent didn’t want to make his ladies worry, so he told them what they wanted to hear.
They went back to waiting for Elaine to wake up. Thankfully, after an hour, she opened her green eyes and then stood up.
She walked closer to Alina and hugged her tightly.
"Thank you, sister Alina," Elaine said, smiling as she buried her face in her chest, showing how happy she was at the moment.
"Don’t worry about it. After everything, I will do the same for your father." Alina brushed her hair and patted her back. "You are now my sister, so get ready to have all the amazing stuff."
The ladies examined Elaine’s body for a few minutes before they stepped back.
"Kent, help me with the curse. Reattach her head and hold her down for a few seconds," Alina said, and Kent walked closer to the beheaded corpse. He did as he was told.

Right when the head landed on the body, it came back to life. However, Kent was a step ahead, so he held her firmly as Alina took out the Celestial Portrait of the Eternal Garden and opened it just large enough to do what she wanted.
An elegant brush appeared in her hands, and then, using it, she drew a few symbols in the air. After she drew the last symbol, she waved the brush, and the symbols flew and entered the cursed body.
"You can let go now," Kent said, letting go and leaving the curse to stay on the ground.
Alina walked closer and crouched down before it. "I will name you Tita. Go inside the garden and continue to grow. When I need you, I will come for you."
The curse surprisingly nodded and flew, entering the Eternal Garden. The portrait shrank and entered Alina’s forehead.
They moved back to Elaine, who was about to explain how she felt after the curse had been removed.
"I have awakened a power that allows me to have control over life and death. However, all those abilities are beyond me.
The current me is just a Life King, so I need to grow some more before I can start using it. However, that doesn’t mean I can’t use my innate body and abilities.
The new me can cultivate herbs to great levels. The current herbs we have in our garden are just Tier 5, but I can now cultivate them to Tier 8 despite being at Tier 7.
And if that is not enough, I can harness the Tier 8 essence in these herbs to cure harrowing injuries and disease.
Also, I can heal anyone below the Core formation completely of their injuries, regardless of how life-threatening it is."
Her sisters nodded, smiles playing on their lips. They were happy for her, knowing she wouldn’t be on the sidelines anymore.
But Elaine was not done.
"As for my combat abilities, I only have one, and it’s this." Elaine spread her right hand, and a tree grew in her palm.
"This is the Razor Blade Immortal Plant." Vexthra immediately recognized the plant.
"Indeed." Elaine smiled. "I can only use 30 leaves at the moment. But though I am just a level 2 Root Transcendent, nobody in that realm can beat me in combat."
"Oh, we have a confident one here," Neomi joked, making her sisters laugh. However, Vexthra just smiled.
"She is telling the truth. The leaves on this tree are called Immortal Razor Piercers. They are very powerful and can, to some extent, ignore all defenses and pierce the soul.
However, in its current form, no Transcendent will be able to defend against it, unless, of course, your defense is as robust as a Root Sovereign."
"Wow, but I thought Life Magicians were more about saving life and not taking it." This time it was Lady Vari who spoke.
Elaine smiled guiltily. "That is indeed true. However, I am not just a Life Magician; I am also a Death Magician. My innate body gives me control over life and death.
So naturally, I must have the means to claim the life of someone instead of just healing." She turned and looked at the overcheerful Kent.

"Also... I can use this method to protect my man." Her voice broke as her cheeks turned beet red. It was her first time, after all, calling Kent her man. Her sisters burst into uncontrollable laughter, watching her flustered look.
After a few minutes, they stopped and had to listen to all she had to say. After that, Kent called Val for her True Name awakening.
The ladies were very happy for Elaine, but most importantly, they were looking forward to when her True Name awakened. They knew that once that happened, her true potential would be unleashed.
Kent put Val’s blood on the True Name Yoken. When he added his blood, sword qi started to fill the Soul Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 574: Selunara, Moonlit Gale [Bonus]
paragraphs: Long ago, during the age of the gods, the Moon Goddess, Lunar, roamed the universe just like her fellow gods and goddesses, looking for the best race to become her earthly champions.
She visited millions of worlds, but at every turn, no world seemed to impress her—that was, until she crossed paths with the Gale tribe.

They were a tribe known for migrating from one location to the next, in search of a place they could call home. However, after searching for thousands of years, they never found one, so they keep on searching.
But just as the Moon Goddess found what she was looking for after meeting them, they also found what they wanted.
You see, every god had to have champions during the age of the gods. Most gods, greedy as ever, went and claimed all the bigger worlds, housing multiple races.
They knew if they blessed an entire world with their blood, they would birth many champions to do their bidding, thereby keeping themselves relevant and ensuring their fate would never waver.
But the Moon Goddess wasn’t after that. Her expectation wasn’t to find a big race that could become her champion.
She wasn’t after a large race that could produce many champions; she was after a race that would be dedicated to her and her alone.
So the moment the Moon Goddess Lunar came across a tribe of 2,000, she felt they were the people she had been waiting for.
She blessed them with her blood, and that was when the Gale race became the LunarGale race, blessed with the innate ability to harness both the wind (gale) and the power of the moon (lunar).
The LunarGale suddenly found their place in the universe, and under the leadership of the Moon Goddess, they found a home they could call their own.
For thousands of years, they trained and produced many Lunar Champions.
However, regardless of how much the Moon Goddess expected from them, she was impressed with her gains. So, despite not having the might to compete with the other gods, she was happy.
However, thousands of years later, when the war of the gods started, the Moon Goddess fell, ending her legacy.
But did she truly die?
Millions of years after she fell, a rare celestial alignment during a full moon eclipse saw the birth of one of the greatest warriors ever.
They called her Lunessa, the one who harnesses the moon.
Lunessa was a no-name lady born into the now larger and stronger LunarGale race. Though their goddess fell, the moon still shone, so they thrived and continued to do so even after millions of years.
Lunessa joined the Silver Crescent Academy, a school dedicated to training elite swordsmen and women who uphold the legacy of the Moon Goddess.
That was when her life changed.

On her 16th birthday, during which the Moon Ritual was performed to call forth the blessing of the moon to guide and strengthen young warriors, Lunessa awakened the mark of the Moon Goddess, and that was when her legacy started to rise.
Legends spoke of her as one of the fastest people in the universe. Her speed was blinding, and her reflexes were on a different level.

The legends told of when the enemies of the moon—shadow wraiths and corrupted spirits arrived, she led the Lunar Guards in a 200-day battle that saw the extinction of one of the greatest dangers to the universe.
This act of bravery and commitment earned her the true name Selunara, Moonlit Gale. She was the one who could harness both the moon cycles and the wind patterns.
When the creatures of the Void attacked, in order to protect her race, she joined the battle, and that was the last time she was ever heard from.
Nobody knew where she went, whether she fell or survived the onslaught.
Many even speculated she was the reincarnation of the Moon Goddess, and that she transcended after the battle, blessing them from above.
However, to this day, the LunarGale race has never lost hope and still prays to the Moon Goddess using the name of their one true warrior, Lunessa.
However, today, things seem to have changed for many people. Far in the cosmos, every last moon seemed to come to life, brightening the sky as if something extraordinary was happening.
Meanwhile, inside the Soul Tower, all 13 moons in the sky were lit up, and a gale of wind as sharp as a razor was blowing around Val as she hovered in the air, surrounded by a mass of lunar energy.
’Looks like most of my ladies have a thing for the moon. I wonder why that is,’ Kent said to himself, watching Val go through her awakening.
Suddenly, a moon crescent appeared on Kent’s forehead, making him smile.
"The gale washed over battlefields, bringing death to all who stood in her way. The one that commanded the moon and harnessed its power to dominate.
She who was favored by the universe, the one who impressed the moon, the heir of the moon.
They called her by many names, referred to her by many titles.
But she goes by one name: Selunara, Moonlit Gale.
Your name still echoes in every corner of the cosmos and on battlefields, awaiting you to take arms and grace the battlefield once more.
Rise, Selunara, Moonlit Gale, your destiny awaits."

The moment Kent said what had to be said and invoked her true name, the wind suddenly stopped, and then from the sky, a white sword with blades glowing under the moonlight flew and entered Val’s hand.
She raised it, and a powerful energy shot from it, entering the clouds.
Far in the reaches of the High Worlds, a pillar lit up, and the moon that had never completed a full cycle before finally turned full, illuminating the night sky.
"The Moon Goddess has risen," a voice called out from within an elegant temple, spreading millions of miles away. Every last citizen went to their knees, and in unison, all chanted simultaneously,
"We hail the Moon Goddess, may your name flourish and nourish the dying night skies."
Back inside the Soul Tower, Kent watched as energy from the 13 moons moved and entered Val’s body. After a while, the energy transfer stopped, and she flew down straight into Kent’s arms.

chapters.title: Chapter 575: The Moon Goddess
paragraphs: Val came out with the look of someone worthy of the title, the Moon Goddess.
Her appearance had greatly improved, and though she hadn’t become completely different, her looks had improved significantly.

She was slender and perfect, accentuated by her hips. Her white hair flowed down her back, and her striking, bright blue eyes seemed to glow with an inner light. Looking into them felt like looking into the moonlight.
She wore a deep navy-blue cloak and garment adorned with gold celestial embroidery and star patterns. The fabric looked rich and textured, flowing naturally as it draped over her shoulders.
Looking at her clothes, it was clear that they were her battle armor, considering it was rich in millions of formations connected directly to the moon.
It would take someone very powerful, wielding a powerful weapon, to destroy it.
Her face was smooth and delicate with a porcelain-like complexion. She had high cheekbones, a straight and elegant nose, and soft lips.
Intricate, glowing, star-like patterns decorated her forehead and cheeks. However, they vanished when she landed on the ground along with her sword.

This time, Vexthra didn’t recognize the sword, meaning the Supreme Celestial wouldn’t be crying bitter tears. Not that Vexthra minded seeing one more item taken from that bastard she hated deep within her soul.
Like the rest of her sisters after their awakening, Val went in for a kiss from her man before pulling away.
"How do you feel?" Kent asked.
"I feel fine... more than fine even. I feel great. I feel like I am connected to the moon, that it will obey my command anytime, any day." She smiled happily.
"Also, I have awakened 30% of my bloodline and gained a unique ability called Moon Goddess Ascension.
When used, I will temporarily become the Moon Goddess and be able to use her abilities for ten minutes.
The time is limited, but I can be likened to a goddess in those ten minutes."

"...This... isn’t it too overpowered even for someone with a true name?" Zaila’s Primordial Spirit said, looking shocked. But it wasn’t only she who was shocked; the ladies couldn’t help but feel the same.
"Is there a cooldown time?" Kent asked.
"Yes. One lunar cycle, so a month," Val responded.
"Just a month. Then, can you use it now for us to see?" Kent asked, and Val promptly nodded. She most definitely wanted to see how much she had grown and what powers resided within her.
So she tapped into the Moon Goddess Ascension ability.
Suddenly, she was enveloped by a radiant light that came from the moon. When it cleared, a more elegant form of Val appeared.
She held a staff in her hand that had a half-crescent shape at the head. Her hair flowed down her back, touching the very floor she stood on.
The energy coming from her was, without a doubt, divine energy. However, Vexthra, who was also a goddess, smiled and extended her divine energy, wrapping it around her.
Val was immediately restricted as if she weren’t a goddess.
"You, without a doubt, are a goddess in this form. However, because your bloodline power is still limited, you cannot harness the true power of the Moon Goddess divinity.
If I were to measure your current state, I would see that you can hold back a Spirit Lord and perhaps kill one, depending on your abilities.
However, when your bloodline has fully awakened and your cultivation base rises as far as a Spirit Lord, you could face a God Ascension stage god and walk away smiling.
But if you step into the rank of even a Root Immortal, then even I, a True God, am not sure I would be able to handle you."
Vexthra let her go, but her sisters couldn’t help but be shocked by what Vexthra said.
"Sister Val is awesome. I knew you were special." Unity, as usual, had to hype the rude saintess who had become the Moon Goddess.
Val moved and kissed Kent, keeping the kiss until her form returned to her mortal state. "In a month, I will take my goddess form again so we can have some fun time in bed."
"I look forward to that." Kent, shameless as ever, responded to the invitation. His wives just rolled their eyes.
"To think the rude saintess who couldn’t even last an hour with me during combat now has the power of a god running through her. I have to say, Val, you’ve come a long way," Selene said with a smile.

She and Val were once friends, until it turned into a rivalry, which ultimately turned into sharing the same man. They battled many times, and at every turn, Selene won all the battles, but Val never backed down.
She kept trying until she came one last time to try, but she met Kent instead of Selene. Now, they are sisters. However, the rivalry never died down.
"Selene, why don’t we spar after this?" Val said.
"You will lose, and since you can’t use your goddess powers, I doubt you can last a minute with me." Naturally, Selene was already radiating battle qi.
It’s all linked to her true name.

"We both have the power of the moon running through us, which means you will lose. Plus, you are a Level 7 Root Ascension, and I am Level 9... I think I can handle you," Val boasted, but Selene just smiled.
Kent also laughed and pulled Val by the waist into his arms. "She is telling the truth, my love. You will lose. While you depend on your bloodline, she depends on both her bloodline and sword.
Her sword is made of celestial energy, while she has the lunar energy running through her bloodline. Mixing the two makes her very powerful.
Perhaps you two can compete on equal ground if she doesn’t use her sword. But she is a swordswoman, so she needed her sword just like you needed yours."
Val didn’t seem disappointed. Instead, she smiled and said, "I will surpass you one day, Selene. Don’t forget that."
Selene just laughed. "I look forward to that day, sister."
The environment was suddenly filled with love, something every last one of them felt. Val talked more about her gains. After she was done, Lady Lani was called to start her awakening.
Sitting at the universe’s core, Lady Universe smiled, shaking her head. Dori, who was seated beside her, turned and looked at her and asked,
"What is it, mother?"
"That maniac is about to be awakened."
Dori became puzzled. She had no idea what her mother was saying...or who she referred to as a maniac...
"Don’t worry, you will know when you get back. For now, focus on your recovery."
"Okay, mother."

chapters.title: Chapter 576: Nyxvein, The Veil of Fate (1)
paragraphs: Kalyra, a child who never knew peace.
Her story began when she was just seven years old.
She hailed from a clan called Veilshadow. They are humans with a natural affinity for shadows. They excel in sneaking around, every last one of them.
Naturally, they are shadows.
Kalyra was orphaned at birth. Her parents were never found or known; they never belonged to the Veilshadow bloodline from the start.
However, she had a family.

They took her in, and she lived a good life for seven years. However, on her seventh birthday, a great massacre happened in her clan when the clan chief’s youngest son pissed off a prince from a powerful kingdom.
That day, Kalyra and her family were laughing and celebrating her birthday when the masked men came.
Perhaps due to how demented they were, when they entered Kalyra’s home, the killers started laughing as they slaughtered everyone.
Kalyra lost everything: her family, her friends, her neighbors. Everyone was slaughtered, including her. However, while everyone was bleeding red, Kalyra bled shadows.
Her blood was smoky like the shadows, and when night came, when darkness enveloped everywhere, she came back from the dead.

It appeared she had the rarest kind of Veilshadow bloodline, the Unbra-Veilshadow bloodline. This bloodline existed during the primordial Era and was said to have gone extinct when the bearer died in the great war.
But it appeared again, and this time, running through Kalyra’s veins.
Luckily, or perhaps unluckily for her, she was found by a dark organization of assassins known as the Silent Veil.
There, she was trained in the deadliest arts: poisons, blade mastery, infiltration, and manipulation of shadow energy. Her natural talents soon surpassed her mentors.
Her natural affinity to shadows made her someone born to kill using the shadows as her weapon. Soon, she was unleashed into the world.
It took just a few years for her code name to start spreading. They called her the Joker, for her laughter never faded away whenever she was after you.
It was concerning behavior to exhibit by a human being; however, the Joker was no human.
She was once a human whose happiness was stolen away.
So whenever she takes her own life, the reminder of the last moment with her family echoes in her mind, making her laugh as she kills.
By some twisted cosmic intervention, her abilities are enhanced whenever she bursts into laughter, making her a terror of an assassin.
Her unique behavior soon raised her name to the point that her maniacal lifestyle reached the books of hundreds of assassin guilds, including her own guild, the Silent Veil.
Legend spoke of the ’Night of Endless Blades.’
That night, the Joker single-handedly assassinated 1,022 assassin guild leaders, and the collateral damage she caused numbered in the tens of thousands.
The legend speaks of that endless night when her laughter filled every corner, leaving bodies in her wake.
That night, she destroyed her entire guild, the Silent Veil, for she found out they were part of the reason she had lost everyone.
Despite her tribe, the Veilshadow, having powerful warriors, they all died like dogs. This was the Silent Veil, known for killing without making even a sound.
They sneakily poisoned the warriors of her tribe, allowing this great massacre to happen.
So she slaughtered every last one of them, laughing like the maniac she was.
Then she vanished.
Hundreds of years went by, and just when her name was dying from everyone’s mind, she appeared, this time going after the tyrannical King of Haldris.
Legend spoke of the king who wiped out races just because he had a bad Tuesday. Every tribe, clan, and race under him knew no peace.
He was untouchable.
Thousands of assassins went after him, but none returned—until the Joker visited him. That day, the Joker became an idol to everyone because her blade had set millions, perhaps billions, free.
However, despite her feat, she never felt like she had accomplished anything. Behind her maniacal laughter, she was but a lonely child who lost her happiness when she was seven.
The only thing that gave her purpose was killing. So when she dominated the world, she went into other worlds and continued spreading her name.
However, after thousands of years of killing, to the point that immortals ask her permission before doing anything, she craves something that will set her among the greatest ever.

Along the way, she discovered that her legacy would be nothing but good riddance when she was gone. So, she sought an ending where her name would be written among the stars like her idol, the Silent Reaper.
However, even after years, she never had her chance, so she let go of the waking world and secluded herself in the void where time is nonexistent.
Legends speak of the day of the Shattering Eclipse, when the Void shattered and a Primordial Entity appeared, bringing with it the power of shadows.
Legend spoke of that day as the day the Universe grew desperate again, since the great war during the Primordial Era.
There was no hope of defeating the entity; even worse, everyone was running. But there was nowhere to run.
However, when all hope was lost, legend speaks of the moment the void opened and Kalyra walked out.
They said she walked out, bathed from head to toe in the names of every single soul she had killed. She regretted her actions for some lives she took, but it was already over.
However, watching as more innocents were dying, she couldn’t stand back and watch, so she paid the price, which was her bloodline.
Only weapons, spells, skills, and bloodlines from the Primordial Era could defeat the Primordial Entity.
So she made the ultimate sacrifice, opening the void and taking the entity into it. For 667 days, their battles echoed into the void.
In the end, she used her ultimate move that legend speaks still echoes in the void if one pays close enough attention.
The Cosmic Gambit.
Legends speak of when she unleashed the ultimate move, which tied her fate line to that of the Primordial Entity.

The scroll speaks of the moment a genuine smile appeared on her face for the first time in 399,993 years. That was the day she smiled genuinely and severed her own fate, bringing the entity down with her.
The forbidden records speak of that as the third time the universe shed tears. Thus, on that fateful day, she gave herself a name, one that captured her true essence.
Nyxvein, The Veil of Fate.

Kent stared at Lady Lani, covered in a mist of shadow and darkness, and for some reason, a tear fell from his eyes. But she wasn’t the only one; every last one of her sisters held teary eyes as they stared at Lady Lani hovering in the air.
"They first called her Kalyra, the abandoned child... Then she became the child who never knew peace..."

So, she sought an ending where her name would be written among the stars like her idol, the Silent Reaper.
However, even after years, she never had her chance, so she let go of the waking world and secluded herself in the void where time is nonexistent.
Legends speak of the day of the Shattering Eclipse, when the Void shattered and a Primordial Entity appeared, bringing with it the power of shadows.
Legend spoke of that day as the day the Universe grew desperate again, since the great war during the Primordial Era.
There was no hope of defeating the entity; even worse, everyone was running.
But there was nowhere to run.
However, when all hope was lost, legend speaks of the moment the void opened and Kalyra walked out.
They said she walked out, bathed from head to toe in the names of every single soul she had killed.
She regretted her actions for some lives she took, but it was already over.
However, watching as more innocents were dying, she couldn’t stand back and watch, so she paid the price, which was her bloodline.
Only weapons, spells, skills, and bloodlines from the Primordial Era could defeat the Primordial Entity.
So she made the ultimate sacrifice, opening the void and taking the entity into it.
For 667 days, their battles echoed into the void.
In the end, she used her ultimate move that legend speaks still echoes in the void if one pays close enough attention.
The Cosmic Gambit.
Legends speak of when she unleashed the ultimate move, which tied her fate line to that of the Primordial Entity.
The scroll speaks of the moment a genuine smile appeared on her face for the first time in 399,993 years.
That was the day she smiled genuinely and severed her own fate, bringing the entity down with her.
The forbidden records speak of that as the third time the universe shed tears.
Thus, on that fateful day, she gave herself a name, one that captured her true essence.
Nyxvein, The Veil of Fate.
Kent stared at Lady Lani, covered in a mist of shadow and darkness, and for some reason, a tear fell from his eyes.
But she wasn’t the only one; every last one of her sisters held teary eyes as they stared at Lady Lani hovering in the air.
"They first called her Kalyra, the abandoned child...
Then she became the child who never knew peace..."

chapters.title: Chapter 577: Nyxvein, The Veil of Fate (2) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "They first called her Kalyra, the abandoned child... Then she became the child who never knew peace.
Her life is murder, and her smile is torture.
They called her many names; they branded her with many evil titles. Her existence wasn’t welcome, and her pain was ignored.
She fought for her place, but she was ignored, and when she gazed into the rising sun, all she saw was disappointment.
But in the end, she went against fate and won, becoming a symbol after living a chaotic life.
Her name changed, and her fate transcended. The one called Death’s Favourite is reborn—her name is Nyxvein.
Rise, Nyxvein, The Veil of Fate, for your destiny awaits you."
The moment Kent invoked her true name, the heavens shuddered and a thick darkness descended, enveloping Lady Lani, who stood in the air, emotionless.
Suddenly, a powerful boom came from the sky, and a large scythe appeared. It moved and hovered before Lady Lani’s motionless body.
Five hours went by, but she remained immobile and emotionless. However, a few minutes after that, her body was dragged into a dark portal that opened behind her.
Countless arms dragged her in.
That also lasted for another five hours before the scythe moved and cut a deep opening into the void. From within, a dark, hooded, and masked figure appeared holding a dagger.
Her entire body was covered; even her eyes were burning red through the mask covering her face. She moved, and wherever she stepped, the space seemed to crack.
"Oh my freaking gods... She is a peak Core Formation expert," Vexthra, who easily read her cultivation base, said, eyes widening.
Lady Lani had not only become a Core Formation expert but also undergone five core evolutions, placing her in the same stage as the Bloodvein tribe chief.
But that isn’t all...
Somehow, in a strange kind of way, her body is leaking Void energy, meaning she has mastered Void energy to some extent.
Then there was the case of her scythe now hovering behind her. When her hands touched the scythe, the mask on her face vanished; however, that didn’t make her any less terrifying.
Her eyes were still burning crimson.
She moved, and like traveling through the void, she appeared before Kent and smiled. She leaned in and kissed him. Kent, of course, wasn’t afraid of her, so he kissed her back.
Thankfully, her terrifying appearance washed away when Kent kissed her. Her dark clothes and hood vanished, replaced by yet another dark cloth, but much more relatable now.
Even her eyes changed from red to darkish white.
"You’ve become powerful," Kent said, holding her hand. Lady Lani smiled and responded, "It is all thanks to you finally awakening my true name."
"How do you feel, by the way? Does the new transformation feel scary?" Kent asked, but Lani kept smiling as she answered.
"I feel great. I feel like I have finally become the real me. I haven’t only become strong and am now much more in the skin I was meant to have.
It’s strange, but I don’t feel any discomfort."

"It’s good you feel this way," Kent smiled and then walked toward his ladies, holding Lani’s hand. They immediately swarmed her, examining her body to the point they couldn’t stop touching her long ears.
She isn’t an elf. However, her looks are no different from an elf. Her race, Shadowborn, shares some traits with the elves, like their beauty and long ears.
However, Lady Lani is more than just a Shadowborn; her actual race is Primordial Umbra-Shadowborn. This is a step up from her previous race when she was only known as The Joker.
This makes her someone special, but she is now much more dangerous than her former self. This was even more interesting considering somehow, she had comprehended Void Energy.
"Big sister Lani, show us your cool abilities," Unity asked, and Lani nodded.
She extended her hand, and the Void cracked. Then she put her hand into the crack and pulled out a red dagger.
"This ability of mine allows me to temper my weapons in the void. Every last weapon tempered has an 80% chance to ignore all defenses of those even two realms above me.
But that isn’t all. Every skill I use, regardless of its grade, imbues the attack with Void energy and some traces of Death Qi."
"Wait, you know Death Qi?" Vexthra asked.
"Yes. Aside from spiritual qi, I can rely on two other energies. The first is Void energy, for which I already have Perfect affinity.
I can harness it into attacks and even use it to traverse great distances."

Ingrid, a Voidling who can also do the same, raised her brow. ’Even I can’t casually do that, simply because I am a level lower than her. I am only at the Super level, while she has Perfect affinity.’
She sighed, knowing her time would come soon enough... Lady Lani continued.
"Aside from the Void, I also have Super Affinity for Death Qi that I can only use with my scythe. Honestly, I don’t know where the Death Qi came from, but in that form, I am akin to a death god."

"It sounds like you’ve become a terrifying assassin by all standards. With the power to harness the Void and Death, I say you will give Neomi a run for her money on who the true Harbinger of Death truly is," Vexthra smiled.
Neomi also smiled.

She doesn’t have Death Qi, but she has the aura that makes Death listen to her. So, looking at Lani, who has Death’s favour, was like looking at her younger sibling, who has started walking the same path as her.
The legends of the Joker and Shara are two of the most terrifying stories. They both killed their fair share of people, but in the end, they did something good, and the universe rewarded them.
If they had died with that much blood on their hands, the universe would have made sure their names were wiped from every history book.
"I also have this," Lani suddenly said, taking out a black book with a skull tattoo on the cover.
"It’s called the Death Note."

chapters.title: Chapter 578: Death Note [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Death Note?" Camilla asked.
She and her sisters looked at Lani weirdly, wondering what kind of weird ability she had.
"What does it do?" Selene asked.
Lani looked at Kent and smiled.

The brat who read the Death Note Manga, watched the Death Note anime, and even worked on the live action with a few director friends back on Earth couldn’t help but wonder if it was the same Death Note he knew.
"Don’t look at me, answer their question..." Kent couldn’t help smiling.
...though deep down, he wished and really wished it were the same Death Note.

Wouldn’t that be cool? I mean, writing someone’s name in the Death Note, and it’s a guarantee they will die. This means he could just let Lani write the names of all his enemies and just sit back and watch them all die.
"This is my Death Note. It’s one of a kind. I don’t know where it came from or who made it, but it has blank pages. On any random day, a name and a countdown will appear inside.
Before the countdown reaches zero, I am required to kill the person. Failure to do so will come with some punishment, but if I manage to kill the person, I will be given a random gift.
Now, you must be wondering... what if the name of a god appears in it, or the name isn’t from our world? What then am I going to do?" Lani smiled.
"It’s simple. There are four different colors the names will appear. Each color has a meaning, like strength, location, and many more.
First, if the name appears in blue, it means they are in your world, and in most cases, in my kingdom or perhaps empire, depending on the structure of that world.
Most names in blue are sometimes in the same cultivation stage as me or below me. These names come with less punishment and less reward.

Then there is the green name. That name is still in the same world as me, but a realm or two above me. These killings are marked with great rewards but are also dangerous to execute—if you are an amateur, of course." Lani smiled, saying that.
Her sisters smirked.
It appeared it wasn’t Val alone who wanted to flex her abilities.
However, while they would have loved to say they could take her own, every last one of them, excluding Vexthra, knew the lady before them had become the strongest of them all.
Even Zaila couldn’t help but wonder if she could take her on without her Primordial spirit backing her. Though in the end, they all came to the same conclusion:
’She is our sister; no need to be afraid of her.’
Lani teased her sisters for a few more seconds before continuing...
"The form of names comes in black. Those names are not only outside my world but also belong to powerful people like kings, queens, princes... mostly names of royalty.
They are some of the demented royals who use their power to destroy lives and suppress the poor. Names of higher-ups in kingdoms and empires also come in black.
These missions are high risk since the target or targets can be three or four realms above me. However, there is a catch to this...
Knowing the mission is high risk, the Death Note will aid me in completing it. Basically, I will have to do the killing, but the Death Note will help me with planning.
Though that won’t be needed, considering my abilities are something even Spirit Monarchs should fear. But that is just by the way.
The last color is red, and that is the calamity missions. The names that appear in this color are so dangerous that even those of the same rank as the target cannot handle them.
They can be in different worlds, perhaps hidden realms. These missions don’t have countdowns, so they can take millions of years to complete.

However, it would be best if I completed them fast enough, since piling names will be bad for me. I would be required to finish all the names; otherwise, piling them to some extent will bring some punishment."
"Isn’t this sinister in a way? I mean, you aren’t looking to kill these people, so why punish you for it?" Unity asked, not liking her sister’s new ability one bit.
"You’re forgetting about the gift part," Lilian said, looking at her friends.
"I know about the gift part. But asking one person to go against beings this dangerous isn’t that punishment enough? I mean, why even ask for your help in the first place?"
The ladies seemed to understand where Unity was coming from. However, Lani just smiled and held her hand.
"The red names—I can ask for help from you all. In fact, those who help me complete a red mission, whether directly or indirectly, will receive a gift from the Death Note.
Meaning I won’t be in danger if I have you ladies to protect me." Unity smiled this time, knowing that she would be safe at least with them.
Lani smiled, watching Unity’s smile blossom. The cute archer whose True Name awakening ritual can’t be performed with the True Name Token has become everyone’s favourite.
So watching her smile, she couldn’t help but smile with her.
"You know, I don’t know where this Death Note came from, but I cannot help but wonder if it’s punishment for something I did in my past life," Lani chuckled...
"But it is one powerful treasure I have, and soon, I will know just what it is made of," She added.

"There’s no need to think about that. Whatever you did, I am sure it was noble, and because of that, the Death Note chose you to take care of the scum of society," Vexthra said, making sure her sister got the comfort she needed.
Kent and the ladies nodded at her words. The pain they felt for her during her awakening was a clear sign that her past self had gone through something that brought them pain.
However, now that she had become someone powerful, they could only be happy for her.
"Just wait for now. We will talk about your unique abilities when we are done with everyone." Kent wanted to investigate the matter thoroughly before making his final decision.
He turned toward Zaila and smiled. "It’s your turn, cutie."
Zaila and her Primordial Spirit smiled. The primordial spirit then entered her mind space, and she stepped forward.
She placed her blood on the True Name token, and Kent did the same. However, the moment his blood landed on the token, his vision darkened.

chapters.title: Chapter 579: Secret Realm of The Serpent Queen [Bonus]
paragraphs: From the start of the True Name awakening, Kent only added his wife’s blood and his to the true name token, and when the time was ripe, he would invoke the true name.
However, today, just when he added his name to the true name, his consciousness was pulled into a realm beyond the one he was standing on.

It felt bizarre in a way, but his consciousness was out of his body. On the outside, Zaila, like the ones who had come before her, had risen into the air, and surrounding her was a large bubble of water.
Meanwhile, Kent was pulled into a realm and appeared at the bank of a large sea. The sea was vast, endless.
The waves were also blowing...
"Where am I?" Kent asked, looking around. He didn’t know where he was, but knew why he was pulled there.

"This is connected to Zaila’s True Name awakening, meaning this isn’t simple at all." He didn’t panic. Doing that would be the least expected from someone who had roamed the Sword Valley in that past.
Though Kent was no mind cultivator, his mental strength was robust enough to handle this. However, that didn’t mean he wasn’t taken aback by the sudden change in the environment.
Since he couldn’t panic, he might as well do what he does best and look for an answer using his enchanted eyes. He activated them, and like he expected, something appeared, but it wasn’t much.
⟦Name: Secret Realm of The Serpent Queen⟧
⟦Description: This is the secret realm of the Serpent Queen, the mother of mind cultivation⟧
"The Serpent Queen," Kent widened his eyes, reading that name. Suddenly, something clicked, causing him to widen his eyes again.
"They couldn’t be right all along, right?" he wondered.
Zaila and her Primordial spirit had already speculated about the true nature of their existence, especially the Primordial spirit.
The suspicion was there, though she wasn’t about to claim Zaila’s primordial spirit was the Serpent Queen.
However, this made Kent wonder if there was some truth to what they said.
Though his suspicion wasn’t far from the truth.
Just when he was wondering, the reason he was brought to this secret realm started to unfold.
From a distance, a small boat could be seen floating toward him. When it drew close, a voice entered his mind, making Kent wonder what was happening.
"You seek to know me, to figure out who I truly am. You must prove yourself worthy by crossing the tide to get those answers. Know that your powers are useless here; only your mind can save you."
Kent wanted to scream, "Bitch, I made no such attempt to know about you, so let me go."
However, he knew what she said was indeed the truth. His subconscious wanted to know more about the true names, and this sounded like the best chance to do so.
So when the boat landed on the shore, he hesitated only for a moment and entered. Then the boat started moving again, this time deep at sea.
"I must prove myself by crossing the tide... just what is that supposed to mean?" Kent wondered as he moved with the boat going deeper.
"If my powers aren’t working here, then I guess this has something to do with a mental battle. I’d better prepare." Kent mentally prepared himself.
He continued to move deeper. A day passed without him even knowing it, yet he hadn’t reached his destination, or the tide hadn’t come.
He just sat there, wondering what this tide was and how it would come. After a while, his thoughts drifted to his ladies, and he wondered how much time had passed on the outside.
After thinking about that for a while, his mind went back to the Serpent Queen. Before long, a week passed. This time around, Kent chose to wait out the tide by catching a free sleep.
He sat and leaned against the side of the boat, only to drift into sleep the next second.
When he woke up, the sun was at its zenith, and the weather looked cool and calm despite the scorching rays coming from the tiny holes in the roofing.
It was a bizarre weather, one that carried nothing but pain.
Kent moved his arm to wipe the sleep from his face, but that was when his hand couldn’t reach his face. The sound of chains rattling assaulted his senses, making him close his eyes.
When he opened them and looked, he saw thick enchanted chains bound to both arms.
"What?" Kent exclaimed, not knowing what the hell was going on. His arms were bound, and looking at his legs, the same chains were wrapped around them.
"What the hell is going on?" Kent wondered, looking around. He saw he was in a small room, possibly a prison, decorated with runic symbols.
Without knowing how, he managed to decipher the meaning of those runes.
"These are all restriction runes. They are meant to suppress my power, even completely remove it." He took a deep breath and started pulling to see what was going on.
After a few futile attempts, he tried to connect to the tower but found out he couldn’t either. That was when a smile, instead of panic, appeared on his face.
Then his gaze turned cold, and using all his strength, he pulled hard on the chains—so hard that when they snapped apart, the entire prison walls shuddered.
The smile on his face slowly changed into anger. Tapping into that anger, he broke free and, using the same anger, kicked the metal door, sending it flying.
Kent didn’t know what was happening, but he had a bad feeling—one he had only felt once, and that was the day he died on Earth.
He knew his feelings didn’t just come; they had meaning. So feeling this way, he rushed out. However, he came to a sudden halt when he walked out the door.
The space around him changed, and this time, he was standing in front of a large golden gate. It was so big and tall that he had to raise his head to look at it.
However, while its grandeur was something worth admiring, Kent’s eyes weren’t on that; his eyes were on the sixteen bodies hanging at the majestic gate...

sentences.text: From the start of the True Name awakening, Kent only added his wife’s blood and his to the true name token, and when the time was ripe, he would invoke the true name.
However, today, just when he added his name to the true name, his consciousness was pulled into a realm beyond the one he was standing on.
It felt bizarre in a way, but his consciousness was out of his body.
On the outside, Zaila, like the ones who had come before her, had risen into the air, and surrounding her was a large bubble of water.
Meanwhile, Kent was pulled into a realm and appeared at the bank of a large sea.
The sea was vast, endless.
The waves were also blowing...
"Where am I?" Kent asked, looking around.
He didn’t know where he was, but knew why he was pulled there.
"This is connected to Zaila’s True Name awakening, meaning this isn’t simple at all." He didn’t panic.
Doing that would be the least expected from someone who had roamed the Sword Valley in that past.
Though Kent was no mind cultivator, his mental strength was robust enough to handle this.
However, that didn’t mean he wasn’t taken aback by the sudden change in the environment.
Since he couldn’t panic, he might as well do what he does best and look for an answer using his enchanted eyes.
He activated them, and like he expected, something appeared, but it wasn’t much.
⟦Name: Secret Realm of The Serpent Queen⟧
⟦Description: This is the secret realm of the Serpent Queen, the mother of mind cultivation⟧
"The Serpent Queen," Kent widened his eyes, reading that name.
Suddenly, something clicked, causing him to widen his eyes again.
"They couldn’t be right all along, right?" he wondered.
Zaila and her Primordial spirit had already speculated about the true nature of their existence, especially the Primordial spirit.
The suspicion was there, though she wasn’t about to claim Zaila’s primordial spirit was the Serpent Queen.
However, this made Kent wonder if there was some truth to what they said.
Though his suspicion wasn’t far from the truth.
Just when he was wondering, the reason he was brought to this secret realm started to unfold.
From a distance, a small boat could be seen floating toward him.
When it drew close, a voice entered his mind, making Kent wonder what was happening.
"You seek to know me, to figure out who I truly am.
You must prove yourself worthy by crossing the tide to get those answers.
Know that your powers are useless here; only your mind can save you."
Kent wanted to scream, "Bitch, I made no such attempt to know about you, so let me go."
However, he knew what she said was indeed the truth.
His subconscious wanted to know more about the true names, and this sounded like the best chance to do so.
So when the boat landed on the shore, he hesitated only for a moment and entered.
Then the boat started moving again, this time deep at sea.
"I must prove myself by crossing the tide... just what is that supposed to mean?" Kent wondered as he moved with the boat going deeper.
"If my powers aren’t working here, then I guess this has something to do with a mental battle.
I’d better prepare." Kent mentally prepared himself.
He continued to move deeper.
A day passed without him even knowing it, yet he hadn’t reached his destination, or the tide hadn’t come.
He just sat there, wondering what this tide was and how it would come.
After a while, his thoughts drifted to his ladies, and he wondered how much time had passed on the outside.
After thinking about that for a while, his mind went back to the Serpent Queen.
Before long, a week passed.
This time around, Kent chose to wait out the tide by catching a free sleep.
He sat and leaned against the side of the boat, only to drift into sleep the next second.
When he woke up, the sun was at its zenith, and the weather looked cool and calm despite the scorching rays coming from the tiny holes in the roofing.
It was a bizarre weather, one that carried nothing but pain.
Kent moved his arm to wipe the sleep from his face, but that was when his hand couldn’t reach his face.
The sound of chains rattling assaulted his senses, making him close his eyes.
When he opened them and looked, he saw thick enchanted chains bound to both arms.
"What?" Kent exclaimed, not knowing what the hell was going on.
His arms were bound, and looking at his legs, the same chains were wrapped around them.
"What the hell is going on?" Kent wondered, looking around.
He saw he was in a small room, possibly a prison, decorated with runic symbols.
Without knowing how, he managed to decipher the meaning of those runes.
"These are all restriction runes.
They are meant to suppress my power, even completely remove it." He took a deep breath and started pulling to see what was going on.
After a few futile attempts, he tried to connect to the tower but found out he couldn’t either.
That was when a smile, instead of panic, appeared on his face.
Then his gaze turned cold, and using all his strength, he pulled hard on the chains—so hard that when they snapped apart, the entire prison walls shuddered.
The smile on his face slowly changed into anger.
Tapping into that anger, he broke free and, using the same anger, kicked the metal door, sending it flying.
Kent didn’t know what was happening, but he had a bad feeling—one he had only felt once, and that was the day he died on Earth.
He knew his feelings didn’t just come; they had meaning.
So feeling this way, he rushed out.
However, he came to a sudden halt when he walked out the door.
The space around him changed, and this time, he was standing in front of a large golden gate.
It was so big and tall that he had to raise his head to look at it.
However, while its grandeur was something worth admiring, Kent’s eyes weren’t on that; his eyes were on the sixteen bodies hanging at the majestic gate...

chapters.title: Chapter 580: An Unexpected Outcome [Bonus]
paragraphs: Among the millions of things Kent wanted to see, watching the lifeless bodies of his wives wasn’t one of them.
However, today, he stood rooted in the same spot, watching such a sight with his mind blank and emotions turned off.
He couldn’t think or even express anything.
His body was rooted in the same spot, and all he could do was stare at this horrifying sight. It was like he died the moment his eyes landed on it.
His mind, which had gone blank, soon started to stir, and that was when the confusion set in.
He couldn’t think or even come to terms with how this had happened.
First, he asked himself why. But there was no answer except the grim sight of his ladies hanging lifeless. That was the answer to his why question.
He asked who. But after racking his mind, he couldn’t come to a conclusion about who would be able to kill his wives. This raised so many questions.
One of those questions was how it happened. Where was he, and why did it happen? Yet again, the ’WHY’ appeared in his questions.
Then there was the part where he was locked up.
That part then raised the two most important questions: why was he locked up, and how did that lead to the death of his wives? These questions were so daunting that they again circled back to why.
Why was he locked up? What led to him being locked up? When was he locked up? Who locked him up? These questions made him start to go mad.
Then again, when he was locked up, how did they get to his ladies? What happened to the tower?
"Just what the hell is going on?"
Tears started to fall from his eyes as he stared at his ladies, his body refusing to move.
"Who had the spine to touch my wives?"
"...why... just what happened?"
"Why was I locked up, which led to my wives paying the price?"
Kent’s emotions started to appear, which eventually made him start to feel something.
Guilt, anger, more guilt, and hatred—but more than the rest was guilt.
He was feeling guilty, something he knew must be the cause of their death. The anger clearly had something to do with the one who caused this. As for the hatred, he knew they must pay.
Suddenly, the sound of someone crying entered his ears, causing him to snap back to reality. He lowered his eyes, and that was when he saw Vexthra’s bloodied body on the ground, crying.
His senses snapped straight, and without any delay, he ran to her.
However, when he was drawing near, his speed slowed down and eventually came to a halt when Vexthra shot him a hateful glare, something that penetrated his soul.
"Vex, it’s me, Kent," Kent said, trying to make her aware, but this only deepened the hatred in her eyes. She was grinding her teeth as blood flowed from her nose, mouth, eyes, and ears.
"Go back to where you came from," Vexthra said, gathering her energy into her speech. "Where were you when we needed you? Where were you when my sisters were dying?"
"You now have the face to stand here when everything is over, and what, you think I will spread my arms and welcome you. Go away.
Anything you touch turns to ruin, and anything you go after dies eventually."
Kent felt his heart breaking at every syllable coming out of her mouth. He just did not understand what was going on. However, he also didn’t know what to do in that instance.
"Go back to where you came from. We don’t need you." Those lines shattered his heart, and with it, the scene around him also shattered.
Kent found himself standing inside an eerie garden similar to the one inside the harem tower: the Love Garden.

His tears were flowing, and even without knowing it, his sword appeared in his hand, and his strength started to return. It moved so high that his strength soon was at the True God stage before it stopped.
However, he was so consumed by his emotions that his aura alone grew chaotic, destroying the lush garden around him.
"You know she was right, anything you touch does turn to ruin," a voice suddenly entered his ears, causing him to turn.
"Zaila," he called out, but the lady who looked exactly like his Zaila shook her head.
"I am not your Zaila... she is dead." Hearing this made Kent’s emotions flare again. His grip on his sword tightened, but he said nothing.
"Aren’t you going to ask how it happened?" the lady asked, but Kent didn’t even bother to look at her.
"What’s the point in knowing how it happened? Clearly, I wasn’t there when they needed me, and because of that, they all died. I killed them, so why should I even bother with anything?"
"Not even the ones who killed them?" the lady asked with her brow raised.
"If the ones who did were so important to know, Vex would have said something. But all she did was show how much they hate me." Kent raised his teary eyes and looked at the lady.

"Tell me this: would knowing about those who killed my wives bring them back or wash away the hate? I can kill the entire universe, which will eventually include the ones who did this, but I can never gain back their love.
They are dead, and I am sure the last thing they thought about before dying was how much they hate me."
The lady went quiet, hearing Kent speak.
"You wouldn’t actually kill the entire universe, right?" For a moment, panic set in her tone. And when Kent raised his head and looked at her, that panic intensified.

Somehow, Kent was remembering everything. Everything that led to him losing everything. His mind started to crack, and his anger continued to flare as the memories of something made-up started flowing in.
Far at the core of the universe, Lady Universe’s eyes suddenly widened, causing Dori to turn to her.
"Mother, what is it?" He wasn’t even done when Lady Universe answered.
"Go back, Doriana. Chaos needs you, and don’t worry, I will keep the cosmic channel open so you won’t run out this time."
Dori needn’t be told twice. She vanished and appeared inside the soul tower, where everyone was frozen in time.
When she walked close to Kent, she saw his eyes had turned red, and the pain, hatred, and resentment in them weren’t ones she had seen before.
Even the god of hatred and resentment would shudder if they saw his eyes.
She quickly entered his mind, and what she saw made her shudder in her soul.
