chapters.title: Chapter 581: How Far He Will Go For His Wives... [Bonus]
paragraphs: Inside the forgotten temple, the Enchantress wore a panicked expression, watching the same thing Lady Uninverse was watching...the sight of what Kent was going through.
"This wasn’t how it should have gone. He wasn’t supposed to remember something that was made up. This was all supposed to be an illusion... so why is he remembering what isn’t there?" she muttered.
"It’s straightforward," Lady Uninverse suddenly spoke. "It’s because of that event. It fractured his mind and still lingers after all these years."
"Then at this rate, it’s only a matter of time before he remembers, and when that happens, there will be chaos everywhere," the Enchantress said with a panicked expression.
"What should we do?" she asked.
"We do nothing. Interfering will only make things worse, so we do nothing. At this rate, the only ones that can help him are his wives, so we should leave everything to them."
"What if they can’t?" the Enchantress asked.
"Then we prepare for the worst. But I have no doubt they will, because from what I just witnessed, he loved so much. Meaning they are the only ones that can reach him...
If this love is enough for him to threaten to destroy the universe, then I have no doubt he will be able to overcome that part of himself when the time comes with the help of his ladies.
"I hope you are right this time too... if not, I can only wonder what would happen when he gets angry." The two cosmic ladies sighed and continued to watch the events.

The lady stared at Kent in shock for a few minutes, digesting what he said. After a long, hard digestion of Kent’s clear declaration that he would destroy the universe and everything it contains, the lady snapped her fingers.
The space around them shattered, and Kent found himself back inside the boat, only this time, there was a destination in sight.
A painful headache rocked his mind when he woke up, making him close his eyes and grit his teeth for a few minutes before he calmed down.
"It was just an illusion..." Kent’s eyes turned cold; however, a familiar voice entered his mind the next second, making him take a deep breath.
⟪Master, you don’t have to worry. All you saw was just an illusion created by a powerful mind cultivator. I don’t know, but her consciousness still remains, and you are going to her now.
Don’t worry. Your mind is safe, and whatever memory you have absorbed is but an illusion. Don’t worry too much about it⟫, Dori spoke, and Kent nodded.
’Thank you, Dori.’ Though he knew it was an illusion, still, he still couldn’t shake the helplessness he felt when he saw his wife’s lifeless body hanging at the dam gate.
A few minutes later, the boat docked, and Kent jumped down. The space around him twisted the moment his leg touched the shore.
This time, he appeared inside a lush garden where a beautiful lady who looked exactly like Zaila was watering flowers.
Though she was much more mature and beautiful, Kent’s eyes wouldn’t lie to him; it was Zaila, true and accurate.
"Before anything, I have three questions for you," Kent said, not lowering his guard.
Though Dori said this was just a strand of consciousness that belonged to the Mind Cultivator, the fact that she was able to mess with his mind that much was enough to tell him she was dangerous.
So he wasn’t lowering his guard.
"Go ahead..." the lady said.
"First question, are you Zaila’s past self?"
"Second, was any of what you said real? And I mean real in the sense that out of the infinite possibilities, I lost my wives, and the end result was hatred."
"And lastly, would the memories I somehow got influence me?" Kent asked the question in one breath, showing how serious he was.
The lady looked at him long and hard, and then she spoke, "I will answer your questions, but before that, answer one of mine first.
Would you really destroy the entire universe for your wives?"
"Yes." She wasn’t even done, but Kent replied, shocking not only her, but two other women listening in on this.
"Why?" the lady asked.
"You said only one question."
"Show a girl some love, would you? And don’t worry, I will let you in on a secret about the memories before you leave, so it’s not like I will be cheating you here."
Kent took a deep breath, walked toward a table, sat down, and poured himself some tea. He also poured one for the lady.
"Well then, why would you destroy the universe for your women?" she asked after taking a sip.
"I am not an idiot, you know. I am someone who, from when I was very young, knew life requires sacrifice. Now, I can start seeing that I wasn’t kidding by saying that.
I have no idea who or what I am. My true self is still locked behind a bundle of memories that have yet to be retrieved.

However, I do know my life is to protect this universe. I know that is my destiny. However, I wouldn’t ask the universe to protect or look after me while I am at it. If she asks, I will say, ’Look after my wives while I am away.’

So when I return and something I went out to protect fails to protect what is dear to me, then what was my sacrifice for? Did I perhaps choose not to sleep in the arms and spend time with my wives just so I can protect everyone else, all for nothing?

If that is not the case, then I want to return to a happy family. But if I return and everything is as I came to meet it in the illusion, I wouldn’t hesitate to reduce this universe to rubble, knowing those I protected were not worthy of living."
"Many innocents will die, you know," the lady said, but Kent smiled and said,
"A wise man once said, the innocent is just someone who hasn’t committed a crime yet."
Three ladies shuddered, hearing that...

chapters.title: Chapter 582: Her Reasons [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Would he truly do that?" the Enchantress asked, not wanting to believe what she had just heard.
"I believe he will do just that. You know him, the real him. You know when he loves something, he will do his utmost best to protect it.
He protected me once, and so did you, so don’t think for one moment he wouldn’t do the same for his wives.
The question you should be asking now is whether we are doing enough to protect what he loves.
We have limitations on ourselves because we are cosmic beings. However, are we doing enough to protect what he holds dear?
Can we face him when his expectations are not met? I know I will do everything in my limited power to protect him, and I know you will too. But would that be enough?"
The two ladies went quiet, digesting everything as they listened to Kent speak.
"Don’t think too much about it. I am not doing all this training, so I will one day watch my ladies get slaughtered. I won’t allow it, so don’t take my words to heart.
Just take it as me messing with you," Kent laughed and then sipped his tea.
"Alright, you can go ahead and answer my questions." Kent leaned back and started to wait for the lady to answer.
She was shocked, but she had to answer his questions and tell him the reason she was there.

"I am indeed Zaila’s past, the Serpent Queen. I died during the primordial era, so this is just a strand of my consciousness. Not much is known about me simply because I wiped everything about me before I died.
However, I left this consciousness in my Primordial spirit before dying. It was to allow me to meet the one who dares to call himself my husband and test his mindset on how much he can handle.
I am a lot of work, you know, so I wouldn’t want a man who couldn’t handle me." She and Kent also smiled.
"Oh, trust me, I can handle you alright," he licked his lips, making the lady blush. Divine consciousness or not, the brat would make her blush, especially knowing she is Zaila’s past self.

"I hope you can keep up after her awakening," the Serpent Queen said with a smirk.
"Trust me, this Chaos Dragon got you covered," Kent answered, and the lady looked at him calmly but with questioning eyes...
"Chaos Dragon?" she asked.
"Yup. The Chaos Dragon." Kent smiled and winked at her, making the Serpent Queen gasp and close her mouth with those slender arms.
"There is no need to think too much about it. Now, my second question," Kent said with a smile.
In the vast universe, some things or people cannot be spoken about; one of such people was the Chaos dragon.
Vexthra tried, and she nearly died, so Kent knew better now.
"For your second question, the answer is no. What I showed you was just an illusion I created from your happiest memories. The reason behind it was to see how you would handle regret.
And from what happened, let’s just say I underestimated how much you love your wives," the Serpent Queen smiled.
"For the third question, the memories are yours. As to whether they will affect you, I don’t know. But now you know, and what you do with it is entirely up to you."
Kent nodded. "Thanks for answering my questions."
The Serpent Queen nodded and decided to get right down to business. She didn’t have much time to begin with, and now her time had also been cut short due to the turn of events.
"I brought you here because I want to tell you two things. The first being my primordial spirit. I know you met her already, so I will get right to it...
I want you here because of the Ancient Tempering Technique every primordial spirit comes with. This has something to do with my becoming a supreme in the future."
Kent focused his attention on what she was saying.
"I know you already know there are two paths to Supremehood: the Dao path and the Ancient path. The technique I am talking about is for the Ancient Path.
The Ancient path is that after you become a True God, you must create a god body and make it undergo the four divine tribulations.
However, what if I were to tell you this path can start being traversed from the Tier 1 stage?"
"Are you saying you can create a god body from the start?" Kent asked with a raised brow.
"I... Zaila already has a god body. Primordial spirits are the better versions of god bodies." Kent’s brow raised even further.
"God bodies are also called Soul bodies. The gods, out of their pride and arrogance, choose to call it God body. Immortals even call it an immortal body.
And since primordial spirits are the transcended form of Soul bodies, essentially, they are better versions of god bodies."
"Unbelievable," Kent could only smile, hearing something this ridiculous, yet somehow it made sense.
Kent asked, "So you want me to give a technique to your primordial spirit?" The Serpent Queen shook her head.

"I already have the technique or will have it after the awakening. What I want you to do is to make sure I start using it from Tier 1. This is a secret I learned when I became a supreme during the primordial era.
Make sure the new me starts using it from the start. This will make this much easier in the future."
"But she is at Tier 18. I say it’s already too late," Kent said.
Zaila’s primordial spirit is already at Tier 18 in mind cultivation, so asking her to start from Tier 1 is impossible.
"That is the second reason you are here, to give you this." An orb appeared in her palm, and she gave it to Kent. The moment he touched it, it dispersed into sparks and entered his forehead.

"That technique will allow her to either transfer her cultivation to Zaila or use it to expand her mind space. I recommend her mind space. You can also give it to her sisters after they awaken their primordial spirits.
Knowing how smart I was, I have no doubt she would find a way to help her sisters awaken their primordial spirits." The serpent queen smile.
"Very well. I will do that." Kent saw her body start to fade, so he knew he had to hurry with his questions.
After a few exchanges with the Serpent Queen, during which Kent even learned the secret she promised, Kent asked a question that made the Serpent Queen smile.
"Were you and the Chaos Dragon a thing during the primordial era?"
"No, but I wish we were..." Her smile turned into a cute laughter as she faded away.
"I look forward to loving you, Chaos. Don’t disappoint me this time..." She laughed as she faded away completely.
Kent’s vision returned to the Soul Tower.
At the same time, a powerful energy descended into the tower, and an enormous yet elegant-looking red and golden serpent appeared and stopped behind Zaila.

chapters.title: Chapter 583: Nyssalith, Mother of Minds [Bonus]
paragraphs: During the Primordial Era, many powerhouses rose to prominence. They dominated the vast universe, making a name for themselves.
One such powerhouse was the Serpent Queen.
She was known for her impeccable control of the mind. Back then, many of these powerhouses were known for their deeds.
Some are known for the paths they carved for themselves.
The First Necromancer.
The First Soulmancer.
The First Alchemist.
These are all paths created by some people. Though most of these paths weren’t taken to the peak due to many limitations, the Serpent Queen was known to have taken mind cultivation to the peak.
She became one of the few who were known as progenitors.
However, during the Great War, she died fighting alongside the one she believed in.
After billions of years, she returned again. Hovering in the air with a giant serpent behind her was Zaila, the reincarnation of the Serpent Queen, the Mother of Minds.
Legends speak of the one who was able to defeat the Chaos Dragon in combat—the first and the only. They speak of her impeccable methods that allowed her to play the mind like it were a drum.
They speak of her display during the Great War when she manipulated allies, turning them against each other.
Her impeccable display saved countless lives; however, after a gruesome battle with three Abominations from an unknown universe, she fell with a smile on her face.
She died, but her essence still burns, and her true name will be awakened.

Kent stared at the serpent and Zaila, who was inside a bubble of water that had now turned red with a smile. Knowing what he knew, he was looking forward to seeing what would become of Zaila after her awakening.
After a few minutes, her true name entered Kent’s mind.
"She was once known as the Mother of Minds. She who controls the mind. The progenitor of manipulations.
Legends speak of the one who once gave Chaos a run for his money. Many called her Lady Chaos, for everywhere she went, chaos followed.
The one who knew everything before it was even said. The Mind Reader. The Mind Eater.
Her titles number in the hundreds, but she goes by only one name.
Rise Nyssalith, Mother of Minds, for your destiny awaits."
Right when Kent invoked her name, the bubble of red water burst open, and Zaila was revealed, looking as beautiful as ever.
Like her primordial spirit, her form had changed, making her look gorgeous. Her red hair cascaded down her back like a waterfall.
She held no weapons nor wore any armor. However, the large serpent in the air suddenly moved, circled the sky, then turned into energy and entered Zaila’s forehead.
At that moment, powerful energy burst out of her body. She extended her hand, and an elegant-looking red spear appeared in it.
A smile appeared on her lips as she admired the spear... After a while, she put away the spear and looked at her sisters.
When her gaze met her sisters’, they felt as if all their secrets were laid bare for her to see. It was terrifying. However, because they were sisters, none of them took offense at that.
However, Kent made sure she was aware. "Zaila dear, you might want to keep those eyes away for a while; you are scaring your sisters."
Zaila smiled and deactivated the ability she had used.

She flew into Kent’s arms and kissed him just like the rest of her sisters did. Kent, of course, enjoyed the kiss. He then looked at the serpent mark on her forehead, and a smile appeared on his lips.
"Let’s sit down first. I have something important to tell you all, especially you, Zaila," Kent said, waving his hand.
They vanished back to the harem tower. They sat down in the love garden, and he decided to share everything with his wives.
After a while, their jaws hung loose, dumbfounded to learn that he had received a visit from Zaila’s past. Of course, Kent said nothing about the illusion he had endured.
However, that was irrelevant since the main point was ensuring Zaila and her sisters understood their existence was much more special.
"So we all have past selves?" Lilian asked, and Kent nodded.
"The true names, though I am not sure, are from your past selves. I think you all did something impeccable in your past that made the universe give you unique names that only belong to you."
"If that was the case, was I truly that ruthless?" Neomi couldn’t help asking.
Her sister also thought the same, for they knew her names and what they meant, especially her Shara name, which made her the Mother of Killers.
Neomi turned and looked at Velyra, since she was one of the many who worshipped her.
"The Mother of Killers is known not for her beauty but for her incredible talent when it comes to killing," Velyra said what she knew, which only made Neomi want to bury herself.
"I knew it. Somehow, I am a monster in human skin."

Her sisters shook their heads, watching her have an identity crisis. Thankfully, she had a weapon spirit that knew something, so seeing her master struggling, the six-armed lady he got as a weapon spirit appeared.
"The master shouldn’t worry. It is true you once were Shara; however, you became Rakshasa, someone who led armies to fight great battles, saving billions.

Your legend is beautiful. So, while you had a blood-filled past, know that you survived and became someone the universe recognized." After saying that, the six-armed weapon spirit lady vanished back into a spear.
"You heard her. You once were a powerful general who led armies to defend the weak and innocent. You should be proud."
Neomi nodded and chose not to ponder it much for now.
She knew the truth would eventually come out, but until then, she would use what she had to defend and save those she could.
Her sisters were the same. They all wanted to forget the possibility that they were monsters in their past lives and instead live for the future.
Kent saw all this, and a smile appeared on his face. Knowing they were able to take the discovery quite well, he decided to take it to the next level.
"So, I have a message from your past, Zaila. She wants me to tell you to start the path of becoming a supreme right now, and to do that, she gave me a technique that will set you up immediately."
The ladies could only stare at Kent like he was some deity.

chapters.title: Chapter 584: Zaila’s Transformation [Bonus]
paragraphs: "So you are telling us the ancient path to becoming a supreme starts from the very beginning of cultivation, and that Primordial Spirits are even better versions of god bodies," Vexthra asked, having heard what Kent had to say.
"Yes," Kent replied. "Per what the Serpent Queen told me, starting from Tier 1 till you become a Supreme is much better than when you get to the god stage.
And I think she is right. She claimed she was the most intelligent person during the primordial era, so I think she wouldn’t lie to herself."

"She is telling the truth. I truly have the ancient technique she is talking about. After the awakening, it appeared in my mind. However, there is a catch." Zaila’s primordial spirit appeared and said.
"What catch?" Kent asked.

"The technique allows me to start the path right now. However, I will undergo tribulation every time I make a breakthrough. Not that it’s something I should be scared of, but I can’t help but wonder, what happens to my main body after I regress to Tier 1?"

"According to the Serpent Queen, you just have to use this technique to strip your cultivation base to Tier One. However, since you can’t just strip it without knowing where to put it, she recommended you use it to expand your mind space.

This way, not only will it help your main body, but it will also help you hasten your cultivation. And the best part: since you live in a mind space, you can continue to grow regardless of the world you find yourself in.
There will be no limitations on your growth. And we both know the stronger you are, the better for your main body."
"This is too much to take in. I consulted many Supremes, but none ever had even the faintest idea that the path to supremacy can start from the very first stage in cultivation."
Vexthra was really shocked to hear something this bizarre. But she knew Kent wouldn’t lie to her, and even if he did, it wasn’t like he would gain anything from it.
So he wouldn’t lie to them.
This begs the question: What will become of the main body as the Primordial body undergoes the tribulation?
This question alone holds so much that she couldn’t begin to comprehend. At the god stage, whenever a god body passes a tribulation, the main body becomes several times power.
So, what will their main body become while the tribulation starts from Tier 1?
"This means, Vex, you will also undergo the same training path. I will awaken your True Name, and then with the Primordial Chambers, you can awaken your primordial spirits.
Once that is accomplished, you will use the same method to regress your cultivation to the first tier and start again.

Don’t worry. Since your main body won’t be affected, you will still be a True God and even start the other path, the DAO path, with your main body while your primordial body undergoes the Ancient path."
"Would that even be possible?" Vexthra asked. "If what happened to Zaila happens to me, then the chances of me coming out with a supreme Primordial Spirit are high.
Asking to lower it to the first stage seems like a lot of work and probably a waste."

"True. However, from what I know, using your cultivation base to expand your mind space or soul space will not only help your main body, but will also expand your mind or soul, depending on the one you awaken.
This means that even though you will still be a True God, your chances of having the power to fight, perhaps as a God King, God Emperor, or even a God Monarch, are very high.
In my opinion, it won’t be a waste simply because you will be expanding your soul or mind, which benefits you greatly."

"I understand. I guess I will do what you suggest, Kent. You are my husband, so I will trust and listen to you," Vexthra smiled. "Even if you want to wipe out all my cultivation and make me start from the start in both my spirit and main body, I wouldn’t complain."
Her sisters smiled while nodding.
They all trust their man, so they wouldn’t hesitate to do as he says.
This sight made Kent happy.
"In that case, Zaila, you should start your training now." Kent gave her the technique and watched her sit and start to cultivate.
In truth, her primordial spirit was the one doing the cultivating. However, the two wanted to do it together since this was an uncharted path.
Thankfully, the technique isn’t that complex, so they grasped it in under two hours.
"I will start now," Zaila said, forming a hand seal.
The moment she did, inside her mind space, a spell diagram appeared. Her primordial spirit stepped in, and like falling from grace, her cultivation base started to regress.
Meanwhile, the energy coming from her was being absorbed by her mind space, quickly expanding it. First, it expanded to about 60,000 square miles on both sides, then it started to change.
The river changed to a sea simply because the place became enormous, and the water body expanded so large that it couldn’t be called a river anymore.
The sea creatures inside also started to develop, some becoming larger and fiercer; however, none tried to attack each other.
By the time her cultivation base reached Tier 12 from Tier 18, the sea was filled with creatures that had become extinct after the primordial era.
The infamous Sea Dragons were now filling the sea, making it both beautiful and dangerous. But it wasn’t only the Sea Dragons that appeared inside the sea.
The Crystal Shark, one of the deadliest sea creatures during the primordial era, also appeared inside the sea.
When her cultivation base hit Tier One, her mind space became so large and filled with energy that if someone below Core Formation were to stand before this large sea, they would pass out.
On the outside, Kent and his women continued to widen their eyes as they stared at Zaila.
Though her cultivation base was at the peak of the Root Ascension stage, her aura had grown so much that even someone at the peak of the Core Formation stage would be suffocated.
Only one person had ever exuded this kind of aura: the leader of the Hand. That overwhelming pressure, that suffocating presence—Zaila had that now.

Her aura alone is enough to render those at the Core Formation stage useless. Perhaps someone with five evolutions under their belt can handle her, but for now, she had proven something that made Kent want all his wives to have:
They must possess Mind Space or Soul Space at all costs.

So, what will their main body become while the tribulation starts from Tier 1?
"This means, Vex, you will also undergo the same training path.
I will awaken your True Name, and then with the Primordial Chambers, you can awaken your primordial spirits.
Once that is accomplished, you will use the same method to regress your cultivation to the first tier and start again.
Don’t worry.
Since your main body won’t be affected, you will still be a True God and even start the other path, the DAO path, with your main body while your primordial body undergoes the Ancient path."
"Would that even be possible?" Vexthra asked.
"If what happened to Zaila happens to me, then the chances of me coming out with a supreme Primordial Spirit are high.
Asking to lower it to the first stage seems like a lot of work and probably a waste."
"True.

However, from what I know, using your cultivation base to expand your mind space or soul space will not only help your main body, but will also expand your mind or soul, depending on the one you awaken.
This means that even though you will still be a True God, your chances of having the power to fight, perhaps as a God King, God Emperor, or even a God Monarch, are very high.
In my opinion, it won’t be a waste simply because you will be expanding your soul or mind, which benefits you greatly."
"I understand.
I guess I will do what you suggest, Kent.
You are my husband, so I will trust and listen to you," Vexthra smiled.
"Even if you want to wipe out all my cultivation and make me start from the start in both my spirit and main body, I wouldn’t complain."
Her sisters smiled while nodding.
They all trust their man, so they wouldn’t hesitate to do as he says.
This sight made Kent happy.
"In that case, Zaila, you should start your training now." Kent gave her the technique and watched her sit and start to cultivate.
In truth, her primordial spirit was the one doing the cultivating.
However, the two wanted to do it together since this was an uncharted path.
Thankfully, the technique isn’t that complex, so they grasped it in under two hours.
"I will start now," Zaila said, forming a hand seal.
The moment she did, inside her mind space, a spell diagram appeared.
Her primordial spirit stepped in, and like falling from grace, her cultivation base started to regress.
Meanwhile, the energy coming from her was being absorbed by her mind space, quickly expanding it.
First, it expanded to about 60,000 square miles on both sides, then it started to change.
The river changed to a sea simply because the place became enormous, and the water body expanded so large that it couldn’t be called a river anymore.
The sea creatures inside also started to develop, some becoming larger and fiercer; however, none tried to attack each other.
By the time her cultivation base reached Tier 12 from Tier 18, the sea was filled with creatures that had become extinct after the primordial era.
The infamous Sea Dragons were now filling the sea, making it both beautiful and dangerous.
But it wasn’t only the Sea Dragons that appeared inside the sea.
The Crystal Shark, one of the deadliest sea creatures during the primordial era, also appeared inside the sea.
When her cultivation base hit Tier One, her mind space became so large and filled with energy that if someone below Core Formation were to stand before this large sea, they would pass out.
On the outside, Kent and his women continued to widen their eyes as they stared at Zaila.
Though her cultivation base was at the peak of the Root Ascension stage, her aura had grown so much that even someone at the peak of the Core Formation stage would be suffocated.
Only one person had ever exuded this kind of aura: the leader of the Hand.
That overwhelming pressure, that suffocating presence—Zaila had that now.
Her aura alone is enough to render those at the Core Formation stage useless.
Perhaps someone with five evolutions under their belt can handle her, but for now, she had proven something that made Kent want all his wives to have:
They must possess Mind Space or Soul Space at all costs.

chapters.title: Chapter 585: Zaila’s Mind Sea, Power & Abilities
paragraphs: "The changes are just mind-busting. Not only has your river become a sea, but there are millions of sea creatures in here." Kent said, holding Zaila’s hands as he and her sisters explored her soul sea.
There was water everywhere, filled with millions of sea creatures, some even Vexthra didn’t recognise. Thankfully, in a strange way, Zaila knew their names and loads of stuff about them.
But aside from the sea, thousands of mountains littered the space, creating something akin to a mountainous island all over her soul sea.
There were some strange plants too, and this time, Kent and his wives didn’t enter with their consciousness; they were there with their true bodies.
Zaila explained that when her mind space expanded, it became something akin to a world that could sustain life regardless of the form they came in.
It is true that they can enter with only their consciousness, but they can also enter with their main body, which makes it a world.
A young world, but a world nonetheless.
Vexthra even explained that once you become an immortal, your core will evolve into a true world that people can live in.
Most immortals even go as far as creating their own living beings after comprehending the law of creation to the Perfect Harmony level.
Though only one in a billion will waste that much time.
But having a true world means you can keep beings in there, and the best part, you will be the god of that space.
This makes Zaila a literal god in the 60,000 square miles of space housing thousands, perhaps millions, of sea creatures. However, there is more.
Thanks to having such a large mind space, her aura has also grown to the extent that she can now exert more of her mind than when it was merely 6,000 square miles.
This means the current her has become ten times more powerful than the previous her, and even back then, her strength was already enough to shut up even the mother of killers.
So one could only imagine how monstrous she had become now..
The only downside now is that her Primordial spirit has regressed to Tier 1, so she can’t help her until she rises again.
"So, do you like, have the power to summon this creature to fight for you?" Ingrid asked, playing with a crystal shark.
If people from the Primordial Era saw this, they would probably run away screaming. A crystal shark was one of the powerful sea beasts that could harness both water and ice.
During the Primordial Era, they were creatures that caused great mayhem everywhere. Crossing the sea or oceans was impossible then.
Without the means to contend against them, passing through the sea would be the last thing one wanted.
However, not only are they friendly and playing with mere mortals, but these mortals even want to know if they can be used as a fighting force.
And the answer is, "Yes. They can help me in battle. However, my current self is too weak to even consider comprehending the technique for controlling them.

I must at least be at the Spirit King stage to comprehend it. Thankfully, I have an intelligent Primordial spirit that can do that once she rises back up. So, yes, one day, I will be able to command every last sea creature here."

"That will be awesome. You alone will have an army that can go against the armies of great kingdoms. I can’t wait to see that." Vexthra and her sisters smiled happily as they jumped on the sea dragons and started riding them across the sea.
The only ones left at the shore were Kent and Zaila’s primordial spirit.
"They look happy," Kent said, and the primordial spirit nodded with a smile.
"By the way, I have a name now. You can call me Y’lyssai; that was my name in my past life," the primordial spirit said, and Kent turned and looked at her strangely.
"You already started having memories of your past self?" he asked, but Y’lyssai shook her head.
"Not yet. I only remember my name somehow. However, I am sure the moment I start comprehending the ancient path technique, the memories will come," Y’lyssai answered, making Kent smile.
"I guess that will be cool. Knowing about your past will have great effects on you, trust me. I know what I’m talking about." Kent placed his head on her lap and looked up at her.
"The name is a mouthful, so why don’t I shorten it and make it Lyssa?"
"Whatever makes you happy, I guess. In any case, I will be in seclusion for the next couple of years, perhaps even the next ten years, and try to bring my cultivation back to Tier 18.
This is so I can help my main body get the most out of our inheritance. So don’t miss me too much."
Kent just chuckled. He still didn’t fully understand Primordial spirits, but looking at Lyssa, he could tell she was very intelligent, which showed how profound they were.
"I look forward to what you will do in the future," Kent said. A few seconds later, he yawned and then dozed off, entering a deep sleep.
A few hours later, his wives came back.
"He is asleep, huh?" They looked at his sleeping face and smiled.
"He’s not telling us everything that went on when she visited my past, but I think he needs this sleep, so let’s let him," Lyssa said, and the ladies nodded.
Soon, they were back inside the Harem tower, where Kent was allowed to rest.
Meanwhile, the ladies went back to the garden, and Alina retrieved the Celestial Portrait of the Eternal Garden for them to view.
This time, even Vexthra joined them. Then, a few hours into the viewing, Elaine gained enlightenment. Her sisters soon followed with Vexthra, the goddess being the last.
She had dreamed of having the chance to view this portrait for millions of years now, but the Supreme Celestial only allows his close friends access.
Now, she can view it millions of times if she wants. After all, it now belongs to her sister. So she won—in the end, all the years she spent hating the supreme Celestial paid off.
They all gained enlightenment, bringing them closer to breaking their limits and raising their strengths.

chapters.title: Chapter 586: Welcome to Blood City
paragraphs: To his wives, it had only been hours, perhaps a few days, since Kent started the True Name awakening ritual.
However, to Kent, thousands of years had passed when he mistakenly remembered something that wasn’t even there.

At most, he was meant to stay in that illusion for 10 days. However, he ended up staying in it for 102,800 years, even remembering up to the point he was a True God. That was something that could break any mind.
Thankfully, Dori intervened and helped him put that memory aside. Though it is still there, it wouldn’t influence him unless he wanted it to, by which he would have to tap into it.
But due to all this, his mind was under so much stress that he drifted into a very long sleep when he let himself relax for a bit.
When he woke up, he felt his body relax, and all forms of stress on his mind were gone. Naturally, he woke up refreshed, and his clarity was on another level.

"Gaia, how long was I out for?" Kent immediately asked, knowing he had been asleep for a long time. His cultivation base was sitting at the peak of the Root Ascension stage, meaning his ladies had made great progress while he was asleep.
The fact that he moved two realms could not happen within a day. So he knew he was out for a while now.
⟪The master was out for 70 days.⟫ Gaia responded.
"Well, that was unexpected, but I deserve some sleep every now and then," he said, smiling.

⟪The master indeed needed that sleep. However, while you were asleep, a lot of things happened. First, we completed the City 30 days ago. Also, we created a Primordial Chamber for every one of your wives.
Talking about your wives, they are now monsters, and lastly, the Bloodvein tribe finished packing since it has already been three days for them.⟫
"Thanks for the update, Gaia. I will play wrestling with your sisters later." Kent freshened up and left to meet his ladies.
When he was a couple of meters away from his wives, they sensed him, and like the loving wives they were, every last one of them jumped into his arms.
He welcomed them with a kiss, including Elaine, Lady Vari, and Velyra this time. Since he added them to his harem, they’ve become much more rooted in the life they’ve stepped into.
"There is something different about you girls," Kent said with a curious expression. He studied them briefly before his eyes widened when he saw something shocking.

Except for Unity, Alina, and Elaine, who were still at the Root Ascendant level, and Velyra, Vari, and Lani, who were at the Core Formation stage, the rest had all broken into the Root Sovereign stage.
Elsa, Val, and Lilian were at the 2nd level; Neomi, Ingrid, and Selene were at the 3rd level; and Camila, Mara, Zaila, and Nara were at the 5th level.
"How?" Kent couldn’t help asking.
"It’s all thanks to Alina’s Eternal Garden Portrait. It allowed us to gain enlightenment and some other things that only the portrait can give," Vexthra replied.
"Even you," Kent raised his brow.
The Eternal Garden contains more than just flowers and plants. It includes scenes of battles, decisive moments in some heaven-shattering duels, and even enlightened moments of most celestials.
Basically, it’s the treasure anyone would like to cultivate with. But there is more.
Aside from having the power to easily gain enlightenment, if one gains the said enlightenment and performs well, the portrait will reward the person.
Most gain powerful techniques, some a deeper understanding of the path they are following, but in most cases, a leap in their cultivation base is the gift they will receive.
It was one of the main reasons why the Supreme Emperor held it close to his heart. Now, Kent’s wives have it.

Aside from Unity, who gained enlightenment on the path of the bow and later received even more knowledge from a supreme being who lived during the primordial era, who was known as a master of the bow, the rest gained a chance to take a massive leap in their cultivation.
"This is too much to digest now." Kent shook his head. He couldn’t just understand how his luck could be this great.
He checked his undistributed stat points, and what he saw shocked him.
[Attribute Points: 2,990,900]
Aside from that, his soul had also reached Tier 12 and even moved further toward the 13th Tier. As for his mind, he now understood where the clarity came from when he woke up.
"Gaia and her sisters are done building the city, so we should go check it out before we go back to the Dead Region," Kent said, taking his ladies to the Mountain Garden.
The sight that greeted them in the city left their jaws hanging when they appeared inside the Mountain garden.
Far in the distance, the crimson city greeted them.

"Wow, that is magnificent." For even a god to say that, the city was indeed a sight. On one side, there was the white, blue, golden, and green city the humans lived in, and on the other side, there was a majestic red city that, instead of looking terrifying because it was red, was rather beautiful.
The buildings are red and extend high into the clouds. The plants in the garden are also red, with some dark and white ones.
Of course, the sun and moon aren’t red, which, in this case, will make the city much brighter so that the non-Bloodveins will not feel suffocated.
A few things are not red, like some trees and pools.
However, the roads are even made red with white pavements.
Even the sky up there looks red. Most of the buildings are 5 to 7 stories tall, but the one sitting in the middle extends into the clouds, showing that it’s where the tribe’s leader lives.

Kent and his ladies got into a flying ship and moved closer to inspect. There are training grounds and even a portal that leads to the Chaos Pool, where the chaotic energy there can even take them to the Perfect stage.
The air is thick with blood qi, and every pool there is made of blood qi and Chaos qi. Being inside the city is enough to elevate your comprehension of the Chaos energy.
After examining everything, they also explored the outer reaches of the Bloodvein ancestral grounds. That was Gaia’s way of gifting them techniques exclusive only to the Bloodvein tribe.
Of course, most of those techniques are also from the Vampires that they copied from the higher worlds. But in the end, they made the city the best one yet.
The humans had already started walking around there, admiring the new city.
"They are going to love this place," Velyra said, wiping the tears from her eyes. The city is just perfect for her race.
"In that case, welcome to Blood City." Gaia and her sisters appeared, causing fireworks to light up the sky as they pulled off the cloth to reveal the name of the new city:
’Blood City’

chapters.title: Chapter 587: Moving the Bloodvein Tribe Into The City (1) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Gaia, Dori, and Akira, you have outdone yourselves this time," Kent said, holding Gaia and Dori in his arms. Akira clung to his neck like a koala bear.
The three giggled, watching the city with their master. Velyra and her sisters were on the ground exploring the city, building to building.
⟪Don’t worry too much, master. We can turn this place into a Celestial world with enough tower points. We have already surpassed the Medium world, so it’s only a matter of time and tower points.⟫
Kent smiled, hearing that. But he couldn’t deny her claims, though. The city indeed is akin to a high world. This means with enough tower points, they can do wonders.
After a while, the ladies returned with excited looks.
"This place is perfect," Velyra smiled.
"In that case, why don’t we go bring your people?" Kent said, and his wives nodded. However, before they could leave, Elaine’s mom and a few ladies in the city flew toward them.
"Kent, we would like to know when our new neighbours will be coming so we can prepare," Lady Rain asked.
"They will be here within the next ten days," Kent responded, and Lady Rain, alongside the ladies, smiled.
"That is enough time to prepare a welcome meal."
Kent and his ladies smiled, hearing that.
"You go ahead and do that, Lady Rain. If you need anything, tell Gaia," Kent said, and the overly cheerful mother-in-law smiled.
"See you all in ten days." Kent waved his hand. The next second, he and his ladies appeared in the air inside the Bloodvein tribe, drawing everyone’s attention.
Some even drew their weapons, but they lowered them when they saw Velyra and Kent.
"It’s the priestess... and our saviour," they exclaimed, looking toward Kent with revered expressions.
"Who are the others...?"
"They look like our saviour... I say they are his friends."
"Dumb head, they clearly are his wives... Can’t you see how they are all around him?"
Kent and his wife’s appearance started to cause a bit of a stir. Thankfully, the tribe chief and the elders were quick to come out.
The moment they appeared, the commotion died down.
"Kent, you are back," Tribe Chief Malthar said with a relieved sigh. Seeing his daughter in one piece made him very happy.
"Let’s go inside first," Tribe Chief Malthar said before turning to his people, "Hurry up with your preparations, we will be migrating in a few hours’ time"
They nodded and went back to their business.
Soon, Kent and his ladies were inside the throne room. Tribe Chief Malthar looked around, and at every turn, his expression changed.
Looking at the aura of the ladies around, Kent told him that if his people were to clash with them, the battle would be over in under an hour.
Kent saw this and smiled.
"Let me introduce them. They are my wives, every last one of them..." He went ahead and made sure every last detail of his wives was captured in his introduction.
When he was done, he turned to Velyra and smiled, "And as it appears, I couldn’t hold back my feelings, so your priestess is now one of my wives."
Velyra covered her face with both her palms, clearly embarrassed by how Kent shamelessly made the introduction speeches. It was like he rehearsed before coming.
’All these amazing women are his wives. Just who is this kid?’ the elders couldn’t help wondering. However, after a few minutes, they returned to normal.

"The place he is taking us is amazing, Father. It has everything we need and some things we don’t even think we need. The place is so rich in Chaos Qi that reaching the Perfect stage in this life wouldn’t be impossible."

"Get the people ready, Father; this is a new beginning for us... a new place where we can call home." The elders and Tribe Chief Malthar nodded.

"You not only saved us from our enemies but also from a great disaster. This alone is enough for us to hand over our most prized possession.
All we ask is that in the future, whenever a Bloodvein tribe member is in trouble, you help us help them."

Kent nodded, "Don’t worry, Tribe Chief, I will not stop until I ensure everyone with your bloodline, regardless of where they are, is protected. That is my vow to you, and may the Blood Heart Stone bear witness."
The elders and Tribe Chief Malthar nodded and then excused themselves. Kent stored away the stone and went out.
When he was out of the Bloodvein tribe, he transformed into his demi-dragon form and started flying toward the Dreadclaw tribe.
It took him just an hour to get there. He didn’t want to do it at first, but knowing the friendship between Larkas, Lonki, and Karvas, he wanted to ensure their protection.
He sneakily entered the tribe and left them what he had come to give them. If fate wills, they will meet again.
After that, he came back to the Bloodvein tribe, and hours later, they were ready to start moving.

chapters.title: Chapter 588: Moving the Bloodvein Tribe Into The City (2) [Bonus]
paragraphs: "Everyone is ready, Kent," Velyra said, watching the thousands of her tribe members get ready to be transported into the tower.
Kent nodded, and this time, he formed portals that led directly into the Tower city. He looked at the Bloodvein tribe members and issued the command.

"These portals will take you to your new homes." When he issued the order, the three elders flew toward the portal and entered. This was their way of sending their top warriors to check their new home and ensure its safety before they entered.
Back inside the tower, Lady Rain and the humans were already waiting for their new neighbours, so when the portals opened, smiles appeared on their faces.
The three people entered, brightening their smiles.
"Welcome, neighbours, we are glad to have you." The three elders turned and looked at the smiling humans, and then they saw the red city.
The moment their eyes landed on the city, they looked shocked. However, this didn’t last long, as it would be impolite to leave their neighbours hanging.
"I am Farra, an elder from the Bloodvein tribe. This is Zarka, and the big one is Ureth. We are also glad to be here."
Elaine’s mother and the other humans couldn’t contain their smiles.

"Well, this is us, and we will be glad to meet your entire tribe," Lady Rain said, and the three elders nodded. Elder Ureth flew out. The moment he appeared outside, everyone locked their gaze on him.
"Everyone, let’s go home." With a smile, Elder Ureth flew back into the portal and reappeared in the city.
Hearing what he said, every last one of the Bloodvein tribe members started moving into the portals. Kent, who was at the back with his ladies, smiled, watching this.
This was a new beginning for the Bloodvein tribe. They had a new home where they would be out of harm’s way for the foreseeable future.
As for Kent, this was the start of building a safe haven for those who don’t have anywhere to live. He would make sure they find a home and live in peace with their loved ones.
The migration took some time, but eventually, the last of the Bloodveins entered, leaving only the tribe chief. He turned to Kent and smiled.
"Thank you, Kent. We will forever be grateful." With that, Tribe Chief Malthar flew into the portal, and it closed behind him.
"Well, ladies, time to go," Kent said, and his ladies nodded.
Velyra looked around the space for a few minutes before she nodded. Kent sent them inside, but he stayed. A second after the ladies entered, Sylara appeared.
"Keep an eye out here for the next few days. The moment anyone appears here, inform me." The evil demoness nodded and walked away.
Kent then left back to the Tower.
He wanted to ensure that whoever cast the spell wouldn’t go away easily. This time, he wanted to ensure they paid for their crimes just like how the Dreadclaw and Soulshroud tribes did for theirs.
By the time Kent returned to the tower, the Bloodvein tribe had already settled in, and they were celebrating their new home with the neighbors.
Kent appeared inside the Mountain Garden, so he could overlook everything from a distance. Thankfully, Gaia, Akira, and Dori, along with Kent’s wives, were there to help with everything.
After a while, he left to join them.

They spent the entire day celebrating. Kent and his wives even spent the night inside the city with the others, and the next day they checked up on the Bloodvein Tribe before heading back to the Love Garden.
The Bloodvein tribe truly liked their new home, so Kent didn’t spend much time there, knowing he had things to do first.
He now has the Blood Heart Stone in his possession, so he wanted to get everything done with his ladies, and then he would enter seclusion.

However, to his shock, he broke through a few hours after returning to the garden. He didn’t do anything; he was spending time with his ladies when his cultivation suddenly moved to the Root Sovereign stage.
Upon inspection, he found out the spiritual qi came from the Bloodvein tribe. They were already enjoying the abundance of energy in their new home.
Over half of them were cultivating, while the rest still explored the city.
Naturally, those cultivating were the tribe warriors who were under strict orders from their tribe chief to enter seclusion and raise their cultivation bases to the next level.
They were doing this so they would be ready to help when their benefactor needed them. Kent could only smile, knowing this was his life now.
Aside from being with his ladies, the more people who cultivated inside the tower, the stronger he became. His attribute points had already surpassed 3 million and were still counting.
Talk about levelling up quickly—he had indeed struck gold. This made him wonder what would become of him when he added the next ten thousand and the one after that.
In the end, he could only smile and wait for that day to come.
For now, he needed all the time he could muster to work on himself.

He needed to raise his alchemy to the level of a Pill Saint by concocting Tier 6 and 7 pills. Then he would go into a comatose state for at least a year to activate the Soul Path Vexthra left in his soul.
Once that was done, he would work on his sword path by remembering the three parts of Jest’s memory. He was sure this would push him closer to his goals.
After reviewing his memories, he knew he could form the foundations for the two sword techniques he required to become a Sword Saint.
The last two memories would be handled once he was done with the sword path, pill path, and soul path.
For now, the plan was to awaken the true names of the four remaining ladies he hadn’t yet. He spent another day with his ladies talking about random things.
After that, it was Lady Vari’s turn to awaken her true name. Kent knew Vexthra should be next, even the first, but Vexthra told him her sisters were the priority. She was already a god.
Kent activated the true name token, and the awakening started once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 589: Velythra, the Shadow’s Crescendo
paragraphs: She goes by many names and titles.
Many called her the Silent Requiem.
The Shadow Reaper.
The Silent Stalker.
The Darkness Embrace.
The Cursed Child.
The Shadow’s Crescendo.
But in the end, she was known as the Mother of Assassins.
Her legacy started after the Great War, when the immortals and gods were at war over the remnants of what was left of the primordial era. They called it the Crossing.
There was chaos everywhere at that time. Those who didn’t know what was going on were crushed unknowingly, and those who knew couldn’t save their skin either.
However, the day the immortal fell and everything went to shit, Selinthra awakened. She was but a humble daughter of a farmer and an artisan.
Her dream was to grow up and become an artisan like her mother. However, the day the immortal fell was the day she lost everything, but also the day her bloodline awakened.
Selinthra was not a simple person. Perhaps her parents knew that, which is why they traveled thousands of miles and chose to hide her in a remote village.

That day, when every single soul she knew and grew up with died, Selinthra rose from the rubble and did what no mortal had ever done before. She picked the sharpest weapon she could find and pierced the heart of the immortal, killing him before the god who was after him arrived.
Perhaps killing the one person he wanted alive, the god cursed Selinthra to forever walk the likes of death and never know peace.
However, legend speaks of the day a mortal looked a god in the face and spoke words that to this day still echo in the void:
"You are next."

Those words were so brave that the universe, looking to select a few people to become her weapons, picked her, and instead of becoming someone who would never know peace, she became someone who had both peace and torment.
The legend speaks of the one who has no presence. She makes no sound and feels no remorse for those she kills.
They called her the Shadow Reaper, for she comes and goes with the shadow.
Those who saw her said she had both white and dark hair, and those who knew her said she had two personalities.
They said that when her hair turns white, she uses a white dagger that claims the life of those she wants, and when her hair turns dark, all those marked for death will never escape her shadow.
They called her the Yin-Yang Assassin.
During the Shadow Wars, when every battle was fought in the shadows, she earned her true name, for legend speaks of the day immortals and gods came together to stop her.
That night was called the Coming of the End, for the war that had been going on for a millennium was stopped by a single lady wielding two daggers.
When she fell, her name became a symbol of all assassins. They called her the Mother of Assassins; some called her the Silent Veil.
But the universe called her Velythra, the Shadow’s Crescendo.

Lady Vari hovered in the air, surrounded by two types of energies. One was white, and the other was black. Her figure was obscure within these energies, and the aura coming from her was both benevolent and malevolent.
A couple of hours later, a yin-yang symbol appeared on her forehead. At the same time, her true name appeared in Kent’s mind, causing him to begin the incantation.
"She who slew an immortal as a mortal. The one who looked a god in the eye and threatened him. The one chosen by the universe to kill.
She was cursed, but it became a fortune. Her bloodline birthed the legacy of all assassins, and she was hailed as the Mother of All Assassins—the Silent Veil, the Shadow Reaper.
Rise, Velythra, for your destiny awaits."
Two daggers, black and white, flashed through the air, cutting an opening into the energy shield around Lady Vari.
The cut created a large enough opening and a crack that spread, and soon the entire shield fell, revealing a beauty with one half white hair and the other half black hair.
She was clad in black body armour made of leather, and in her hands were the two daggers—the white in her right hand and the black in her left.

She looked calm, and the air around her was rather subtle. However, after a few seconds, none of her sisters, including Kent—well, perhaps except Vexthra—could sense her. It was like she had vanished.
However, the most shocking thing was that she was right in front of them, yet they couldn’t sense her. Her presence was gone just like that.
She flew down and into Kent’s arms, sharing a quick kiss with him.
"Big sister Vari, why can’t we sense you?" Lilian asked.

"It’s my cloaking ability. Don’t worry, it will be over in under two minutes since I can only maintain it for two minutes tops. However, within those two minutes, only those three realms above me can sense me."
"Isn’t that too powerful?" Ingrid couldn’t help asking. However, Lady Vari just smiled.
"It’s one of the many cloaking abilities I have."
"And why is your hair black and white?" Unity asked. They all wanted to know, considering this was their first time seeing such a hairstyle.
"These are my forms." Lady Vari activated an ability, and her hair turned white. The moment she took that form, an air of righteousness washed over everyone.
However, when she shifted her hair to black, they all took a step back. It was like looking into the abyss when their eyes landed on her.
"In my white hair form, I can harness the power of space and time to some extent. Though not enough, I can use it to assassinate those who deserve it.
But in my dark hair form, I can harness the power of the shadows and the void to create chaos where required. And no, I won’t become a bloodthirsty maniac who won’t know when to stop killing.
It is just that my two forms each have different abilities and skill sets I can use. But when in both forms, I can harness half the abilities of each form."
"Looks like we have another powerful assassin in the family." Vexthra and her sisters dragged her away to examine her further while Kent got ready to awaken Velyra’s true name.
The messages he received after awakening Vari’s true name can wait for now.

And no, I won’t become a bloodthirsty maniac who won’t know when to stop killing.
It is just that my two forms each have different abilities and skill sets I can use.
But when in both forms, I can harness half the abilities of each form."
"Looks like we have another powerful assassin in the family." Vexthra and her sisters dragged her away to examine her further while Kent got ready to awaken Velyra’s true name.
The messages he received after awakening Vari’s true name can wait for now.

chapters.title: Chapter 590: Sanguis Dominara, the Crimson Reaper
paragraphs: The Hemalune were a warrior race that dates back to the primordial era. Every last one of them was a terrifying warrior on the battlefield.
They had the means to control blood energy, allowing them to move faster, heal faster, and tire less.
Yara was no different.
From the tender age of seven, she started training with everyone, and when she turned fifteen, she joined her first battle, which lasted for ten days. That battle was the start for Yara.

When she was born, she was told her parents died on a battlefield, saving the lives of their men. Both mother and father were war generals. They died saving their race from near extinction when the Huxian race attacked.
So from a young age, she was loved and cherished by everyone.
However, Yara only desired one thing: to personally see the fall of the Huxian race. She wanted to use her own two hands to ensure that the Huxian race fell, every last one of them.

They had caused so much mayhem that people ran when their names were mentioned. However, Yara was determined to see their fall, so she trained and kept training until the day she slept and woke up differently.
Legends speak of what was hidden in the void—the forbidden knowledge that shouldn’t have existed. Yet somehow, this forbidden knowledge found its way to Yara, and when she stirred, her life changed.
The legends speak of the day a single entity stood before the millions of the Huxian army and drew her sword.
The legend speaks of when she faced them, and when their blood started flowing on the battlefield, her powers began to awaken.
They called her the Blood Mistress, for when she fought, her entire body was drenched in blood. She became crimson during battles, and whenever she saw blood, her reach on death strengthened
Many called her the Blood Demoness because when she was done with the Huxian army, she was bathed in their blood, causing many to start to fear her.
The universe still recognizes that battle to this day as one of the bloodiest and most chilling battles in history.
Legend even spoke of the day the Yama King came from hell just to see if she was indeed real, for the legend speaks of the day hell was filled to the brim due to one person’s carnage.
They called her the Crimson Reaper, for she uses blood both passively and actively in combat.
Years after her battle, she laid down her sword and chose the life of a pacifist, secluding herself in the inner reaches of the Primordial Flower Garden, where the Everlasting Healer resides.
She chose to live a life of peace since she had completed the mission she had given herself.
And for millions of years, she did, she remained in seclusion, not touching her sword.
However, when the 14 Doom Gates opened and chaos spread everywhere, she picked up her sword again, and that was the last time she was heard of.
Those who knew of the accounts from the Great War could bear witness to her prowess. The legend described her last moments as one drenched in blood and carnage.
So the universe named her Sanguis Dominara, the Crimson Reaper.
Velyra was literally drenched in blood from head to toe as she hovered in the air. A bubble of blood surrounded her, showing that her affinity for blood was warranted.
The scene was just too bizarre. However, like her sisters, she was awakening her true name, and the blood bath she was going through was her purification ritual.
Kent remained still, observing this process with keen interest. He didn’t know how or why, but the blood surrounding her made him feel energised.
It felt as if he called it, it would answer. However, he remained still, making no attempt to do that. Who knows what danger he would be putting Velyra in if he listened to her desire?
A day later, the true name appeared in his mind.
"The Mistress of Blood. The Blood Reaper. The Crimson Reaper. The one who harnesses blood. Even the Yama King, the ruler of hell, was impressed by her prowess.
The one who brought down a race of evil and wiped filth from the world.
They called her the Blood Queen, for she has the means to harness blood to do her bidding. When she was needed, she didn’t hesitate, and that was why she was rewarded.
Rise, Sanguis Dominara, the Crimson Reaper, for your destiny awaits."
The blood exploded, but instead of spraying everywhere, it moved back and entered Velyra’s body or formed around her, creating black and red leather armour.
On her back, red and black angel wings spread, showing their elegance. Her hair was black with strands of silver, and her skin colour matched her affinity for blood.
Her beauty matched her legend, and her aura was suffocating and bloodthirsty. In her grip was a longsword with a red blade and a black hilt.
"Wow, that is the true definition of a warrior princess," Neomi said with a smile. However, this comment didn’t sit well with her disciple Ingrid, who was also known as Warrior Princess.
"No offence, Ingrid, but look at her. She is the type who doesn’t need an army to dominate the battlefield. I think she takes this one," Ingrid smirked, though she couldn’t deny it.
Looking at Velyra, who slowly descended into Kent’s arms, she could tell the title Warrior Princess was befitting of her nature.

"At this rate, I can become one of those spoiled princesses and cause trouble everywhere, knowing I have sisters who will back me up," Val said, showing that despite her new looks and clear signs of being the Moon Goddess, she still had her rude personality.
Her sisters smirked, hearing what she said. They didn’t know if they should gang up on her and beat the rudeness out of her.
But they did know that if she found herself in trouble, they would back her up regardless of whether she was right or wrong.

Kent and Velyra shared a brief kiss before her sisters dragged her away. It turned out she was no longer a Bloodvein but a Hemalune, an upgrade from her previous bloodline, the original Bloodvein bloodline.

Her control over blood had developed to a new level, and right now, even if two level five core formation experts appeared before her, she could solo them within a minute despite still only having undergone three core evolutions
The main reason she had become terrifying was that her Chaos qi was now at the perfect stage, which made her very dangerous.
Kent spent a few minutes checking her new form. Afterwards, it was Elaine’s turn...

chapters.title: Chapter 591: The Everlasting Healer [Bonus]
paragraphs: The legend of the Everlasting Healer didn’t start out as benevolent as one would expect. When people hear the name Healer or Life Magician, they quickly picture a benevolent entity worthy of admiration.
However, the mother of life magicians, the one they called the Everlasting Healer, didn’t start out as this benevolent entity worth looking up to.
She started out with the name The Contractor.
Legends speak of the greatest killer during the Primordial Era. They talk about the one who can kill anyone and anything, regardless of who they are or where they are.
They called her the Jackal, for she always finds a way to kill.
However, to understand where she came from, we would have to know about the first human kingdom to rise during the Primordial Era and why they were the first to fall.
The legend started when the first human awakened a rare bloodline called the Dark Lotus, which is said to have come from the law of death itself.

This human rose through the ranks and soon stood on equal footing with the dragons, Beastkin, Elves, Dwarfs, and other races, who, until the rise of this human, ruled over the humans and made them their slaves for thousands of years.
No human had ever risen to a level that could challenge the other races. However, this human did, and when he got to the top, he realized he wasn’t the only one.
There was another human who also awakened a similar bloodline as his, but she wasn’t a killer; she was a life giver. She protected the lives of their masters, and for years, that was her life.
But when the White and Dark Lotus come together, they become unstoppable. One is the killer, and the other is the healer. That is when humans rose and said no to their masters.
The first human kingdom rose, and humans were freed. Legend spoke of the legendary battle that set humans on the Primordial maps.
However, thousands of years later, the chilling defeat of the other races didn’t sit well, so they came after the humans. That was when the yin and yang saw the horrors of a loyal slave.

Their own people betrayed them, and in the end, they took their own lives, jumping into the abyss. However, what nobody would have expected was the end product of the union between light and darkness.
Nobody expected the coming of the Golden Lotus, the one that wielded both the power of life and death.
The Contractor was born full of hatred and resentment.
She grew up in the abyss where the creatures of darkness dwell, and through battles and tempering, she became a force that one day rose from the darkness and consumed the entire land.
Legends speak of her deeds.
She slaughtered the entire bloodline of dragons.
She made an entire empire of elves sever their ears, an apparent disrespect to their race.
She poisoned an entire ocean, killing millions of sea creatures, and that was just a few of the things she did. She, at some point, became the true definition of fear.
She became unstoppable...
The legends spoke of the day the 14 defenders, chosen by the universe to defend the 14 doom gates, came after her.
These 14 were said to hold unimaginable power; however, when they came, the Contractor was waiting for them, rendering 13 out of the 14 useless.
Only the Chaos Dragon managed to get to her. However, the legends spoke of when he defeated her and was about to drive his sword through her heart, but stopped mid-strike.
The Chaos Dragon let her go for reasons nobody knew.
That was the day the contractor put down her weapons. No one knows what was said between her and the Chaos Dragon.
But she didn’t go back to the abyss; instead, she turned to her life-giver side and decided to heal instead of destroy.
That was when she went from the Contractor to the Everlasting Healer, a being who was the sole reason the Primordial Chaos Dragon managed to stand tall when everyone was fleeing.
Today, the same being is awakening her innate powers, and nobody knows if she is coming out as the Contractor or the Everlasting Healer.
Either way, she earned her name among the legends who once ruled the heavens and stood tall before harrowing dangers.
Elaine was up in the air, surrounded by a golden lotus. The energy coming from it was both calming and evil. Kent stood below, watching this go on for two days until her true name appeared.
"She who holds the power over life and death. The one who holds dominion over who gets to live and die. She was the Contractor, the greatest killer to have ever lived.
Then she became the Healer, someone who healed the universe and protected it when needed. She was seen and rewarded, and she received a unique name.
Rise, Lianhua Zhenxin, the true heart of the lotus.
Rise, for your destiny awaits."
The golden lotus opened slowly, holding a pale-skinned beauty with golden hair. She wore only a lightweight gown, and her body was covered in golden angel wings.
When she opened her eyes and flapped her wings, a wave of healing energy washed over everyone, making them feel like they could drink poison and still live.
Elaine flapped her wings and slowly descended into Kent’s arms. She kissed him deeply and then tapped his forehead.
The moment she did, a message appeared before his vision.
⟦You have received the Everlasting Healer’s blessing⟧
⟦You have awakened an innate ability: Regenerate⟧
⟦Ability: Regenerate⟧
⟦Type: Innate⟧
⟦Stage: Super⟧
⟦Description: Your healing abilities are now amplified 400%. All injuries can be healed within seconds. Severed body parts can regenerate within minutes.⟧
"Thank you," Kent smiled.
Though his dragon’s health allows him to heal 130% faster, getting a boost of 400% isn’t something to take lightly.
"How do you feel?" Kent asked, but Elaine smiled and hugged him. "I feel fine. The new me is more than I could ask for. So I should be the one thanking you."
She smiled and put away her wings. However, her hair remained golden, and her clothes remained the same.
Not that the clothes mattered, but something connected to the soul has meaningful significance, so Kent was intrigued and planned on examining it later.
Kent’s women rushed over to Elaine, and like her other sisters, they examined every part of her new body. Afterwards, Vexthra’s turn finally came.

chapters.title: Chapter 592: The Cosmic Child [Bonus]
paragraphs: The Great War.

The war that defined the fate of the universe. The one where some of the greatest beings to have ever lived fell. That war was the one that shook the cosmos and made every cosmic being shake in their boots.
That battle showed that even the universe needed help—that cosmic beings are eternal, but they are weak when threatened.
Human lives were laid down so they could keep on living.
At the harrowing moments of the Great War, moments before the Chaos Dragon shattered his soul and used it to call forth the 14 Doom Legion, he first gazed into the cosmos and smiled.
At that moment, the Enchantress, the watcher of the timeline, saw what could have been, and for a moment, two teardrops fell from her eyes—one from the left eye and the other from the right.
As the watcher of the timeline, she saw what could have been and what is, and that broke her heart. For a cosmic being tasked with watching, that sight moved her, so she cried.
And two teardrops manifested her feelings.
One was love.
The other was hate.
The love was because what she saw was beautiful. It was something filled with love, something that looked beautiful, and something that made her wish it came true.
The hate was what was—the one that was happening—and that broke her heart. So she cried, and the tears of hate manifested into a person.
However, these new existences weren’t meant to be but were, and that must be corrected. The universe requires balance, so when the universe resets, they were no more.
However, fate had other plans.
Millions of years later, love and hate were reborn. They grew up and lived like normal humans.
But are they truly just that? Were they meant to be just that? This answer came when hate witnessed love taken away by men’s evil.
That was when resentment was born in hate, and her divinity rose. She lived, hating and resenting everything for millions of years until she met a human.
The cosmic child who wasn’t supposed to exist in the first place now has divinity and love in her life. But was that truly who she was?
The love she found—is it enough to manifest her true self? If that wasn’t the case, then can love fix that? And how much love can fix or balance out hate?
The answer to that question is shrouded in mystery.
"Hmm..." Kent brushed his chin when the true name appeared in his mind. It wasn’t like he expected it and didn’t come like the others. This true name was different.
However, he knew it had to be invoked, so he did. He called forth the name...
"She is hate. She is resentful and shall be known as Mal’Thyrria, the Resentful Eclipse. Heed your name and rise, Mal’Thyrria; your destiny has just begun."
A sudden heaviness fell on Kent, sending him to his knees. Then he fell backwards and passed out...
This made his ladies panic, and they wanted to go to his aid, but Gaia, Dori, and Akira appeared and stopped them.
⟪Relax, ladies, the master is fine. He needs to take a nap⟫, Gaia said, making them halt. Meanwhile, in the air, Vexthra was covered in darkness for a few minutes before her body was revealed.
She looked even more elegant, with a dark crown now atop her head. Her hair remained the same silver with some essence of redness in it.
Basically, she became the goddess of hatred and resentment in name, but aside from that, she now embodies the title and its innate belief.
Her body had been reformed to embody her name, Mal’Thyrria. Her gown was also black, and looking into her eyes, one could feel her divinity oozing.
For a moment, her sisters feared for their lives as they gazed into the eyes of hatred and resentment. But after a few seconds, Vexthra returned to her previous self, making them sigh.
With Kent passed out, they knew contending with her would be disastrous.
"Let’s take him inside first," Vexthra said after getting back down. Her sisters nodded, and they carried Kent away.

However, they didn’t leave his side; they wanted to be there when he woke up. After ten days, when he didn’t wake, they knew he would be out for a while, so they decided to take turns caring for him while they waited.
A month passed in the blink of an eye, but Kent still hadn’t woken up.

Of course, his ladies were worried. In fact, they were worried sick, but the three Lolis kept telling them he was fine. After Elaine spent three days using all her abilities on Kent, she finally came to the conclusion that he was indeed fine.
But even so, after three months, when he still didn’t wake, their worry only grew. Thankfully, four months after he went to sleep, Kent woke up.
However, he immediately went into seclusion since his second enlightenment in the sword path happened right when he woke up.
This time, the ladies knew he was fine, so they relaxed and let him finish his enlightenment.

Weeks passed quickly, but Kent remained in his enlightened state, not coming out. Unfortunately for him, the person he was waiting for in the Bloodvein tribe inside the Dead Region came, and Sylara tried to alert him, but when he didn’t answer, she came to inform his ladies.
Naturally, they knew what had to be done.
However, they also didn’t want to leave their man’s side, so Vexthra made Velyra, Vari, Lani, Neomi, Selene, Ingrid, Alina, and Elaine go handle it.
Vari, Lani, and Velyra are all at the Core Formation stage, and the rest are at the Root Sovereign stage, so she knew they could handle the Core Formation demon that appeared.
According to Sylara, the person is a demon who came from the shadows, and judging by his aura, he had already completed six core evolutions.
This made him several times more powerful than tribe chief Malthar. But the ladies are no pushovers either, especially with Alina going with them.
