However, these new existences weren’t meant to be but were, and that must be corrected.
The universe requires balance, so when the universe resets, they were no more.
However, fate had other plans.
Millions of years later, love and hate were reborn.
They grew up and lived like normal humans.
But are they truly just that?
Were they meant to be just that?
This answer came when hate witnessed love taken away by men’s evil.
That was when resentment was born in hate, and her divinity rose.
She lived, hating and resenting everything for millions of years until she met a human.
The cosmic child who wasn’t supposed to exist in the first place now has divinity and love in her life.
But was that truly who she was?
The love she found—is it enough to manifest her true self?
If that wasn’t the case, then can love fix that?
And how much love can fix or balance out hate?
The answer to that question is shrouded in mystery.
"Hmm..." Kent brushed his chin when the true name appeared in his mind.
It wasn’t like he expected it and didn’t come like the others.
This true name was different.
However, he knew it had to be invoked, so he did.
He called forth the name...
"She is hate.
She is resentful and shall be known as Mal’Thyrria, the Resentful Eclipse.
Heed your name and rise, Mal’Thyrria; your destiny has just begun."
A sudden heaviness fell on Kent, sending him to his knees.
Then he fell backwards and passed out...
This made his ladies panic, and they wanted to go to his aid, but Gaia, Dori, and Akira appeared and stopped them.
⟪Relax, ladies, the master is fine.
He needs to take a nap⟫, Gaia said, making them halt.
Meanwhile, in the air, Vexthra was covered in darkness for a few minutes before her body was revealed.
She looked even more elegant, with a dark crown now atop her head.
Her hair remained the same silver with some essence of redness in it.
Basically, she became the goddess of hatred and resentment in name, but aside from that, she now embodies the title and its innate belief.
Her body had been reformed to embody her name, Mal’Thyrria.
Her gown was also black, and looking into her eyes, one could feel her divinity oozing.
For a moment, her sisters feared for their lives as they gazed into the eyes of hatred and resentment.
But after a few seconds, Vexthra returned to her previous self, making them sigh.
With Kent passed out, they knew contending with her would be disastrous.
"Let’s take him inside first," Vexthra said after getting back down.
Her sisters nodded, and they carried Kent away.
However, they didn’t leave his side; they wanted to be there when he woke up.
After ten days, when he didn’t wake, they knew he would be out for a while, so they decided to take turns caring for him while they waited.
A month passed in the blink of an eye, but Kent still hadn’t woken up.
Of course, his ladies were worried.
In fact, they were worried sick, but the three Lolis kept telling them he was fine.
After Elaine spent three days using all her abilities on Kent, she finally came to the conclusion that he was indeed fine.
But even so, after three months, when he still didn’t wake, their worry only grew.
Thankfully, four months after he went to sleep, Kent woke up.
However, he immediately went into seclusion since his second enlightenment in the sword path happened right when he woke up.
This time, the ladies knew he was fine, so they relaxed and let him finish his enlightenment.
Weeks passed quickly, but Kent remained in his enlightened state, not coming out.
Unfortunately for him, the person he was waiting for in the Bloodvein tribe inside the Dead Region came, and Sylara tried to alert him, but when he didn’t answer, she came to inform his ladies.
Naturally, they knew what had to be done.
However, they also didn’t want to leave their man’s side, so Vexthra made Velyra, Vari, Lani, Neomi, Selene, Ingrid, Alina, and Elaine go handle it.
Vari, Lani, and Velyra are all at the Core Formation stage, and the rest are at the Root Sovereign stage, so she knew they could handle the Core Formation demon that appeared.
According to Sylara, the person is a demon who came from the shadows, and judging by his aura, he had already completed six core evolutions.
This made him several times more powerful than tribe chief Malthar.
But the ladies are no pushovers either, especially with Alina going with them.

chapters.title: Chapter 593: Dangerous Beauties
paragraphs: "No... No... No."

A white-haired man, probably in his late 60s, or perhaps due to his cultivation technique, he had aged faster than he should, stomped hard on the ground, veins popping on his forehead as he gazed at the empty expanse of land.

His skin was a little purple, and his veins looked more green than they should. This was a clear sign that, despite his lineage as a shadow demon, he was indeed being affected by the cultivation technique he was using.
But the popping of the veins part was due to what he saw.
Where the Bloodvein tribe used to stay was now empty; not even a fraction of the life that used to be there remained. It was clear to him that they were gone.
His prey had escaped.

The ones he spent the last 23 years of his life plotting against had slipped under his nose, and the painful part was that the tracker he used to track them, even while he was far in the demon continent, was not working anymore.
This showed that he had lost his prey, which greatly angered him.
"Where is my Bloodheart stone?" He released his aura, sending powerful shadowy energy, creating chaos in his wake.
He was pissed, and judging by his reaction, he was very scared for his life, too. Perhaps this wasn’t as simple as it seemed.
Four miles from him, Velyra, Alina, Elaine, Ingrid, Vari, Lani, Neomi, and Selene hovered in the air, looking at him with impartial expressions.
"So he is a shadow demon," Lani muttered, looking in the direction of the demon who was the cause of the Bloodvein tribe nearly losing their lives had Kent not intervened.
Naturally, he came for the Bloodheart stone.
The spell part was for his allies to get what they wanted: to take the Bloodvein tribe as their slaves. That was the endgame for the Dreadclaw and Soulshroud tribes.
But now, both tribes have lost abysmally against the Bloodvein tribe, and the mastermind behind it all has lost his treasure-or, more accurately, the treasure he coveted.
"How are we going to do it?" Ingrid asked. "I feel like ganging up on him will be bullying."
The ladies couldn’t argue with that. Though she exaggerated a bit, if they all moved on him, he would be done for before he knew it.
They are now very powerful, and Vexthra sending eight of them was more like her way of making sure the job was done well.
Any of them could get the job done.
"He is a shadow demon, and as a being connected to shadows, he can make a run for it easily. However, if I were to go, I would lock the shadows, rendering him unable to run.
However, that would be a waste since he can’t run from me or Lani even if he is five times stronger than us," Vari said with a smirk.
"We get it, you two are good at sneaking around," Selene joked, causing her sisters to laugh.
But like Vari said, this was a cool chop for Lani or herself.
"How about Velyra and I handle this? I won’t attack; I will only lock the space around the two and let her vent her anger.
After all, this man was the reason she nearly lost her tribe," Alina proposed, and without even thinking hard about it, the ladies nodded.

What Alina said was indeed true: Velyra was a Bloodvein, and though her race and bloodline changed, she was still the same sexy red, so they wanted the man who threatened her people to be handled by her.
"Make sure he is not dead. We want him alive so that Kent can question him when he is done cultivating," Neomi reminded Alina and Velyra before they vanished.
Far in the distance, the demon sensed someone appear in his surroundings, causing him to draw a weapon. However, even when his eyes landed on Velyra, a smile appeared on his lips.

"Girl, where are your people? I have something important to discuss with them," he asked in a tone that suggested he wanted to see if he could play mind games with the red-skinned beauty. However, Velyra smirked.
"I guess someone who can willingly cast a spell to destroy an entire race would look ugly both on the inside and the outside," Velyra said, and Alina couldn’t help laughing.

This sight pissed the demon off, so he jumped, thrusting his dagger in Velyra’s direction. However, Alina just waved her hand, and hundreds of runes appeared in the air, creating a barrier between them and the demon.
His dagger landed on the defense, and as if it had absorbed the attack, a powerful beam shot from the barrier, sending the demon flying to the ground.

"Oops," Alina smirked. "Sorry, Velyra. I won’t attack him again; he’s all yours." Alina formed a seal, activating a formation. It expanded and covered a three-mile radius, rendering the shadow demon incapable of escaping.
"Blood Slash." Velyra didn’t even let the demon get back up as she unleashed a power sword, sending a blood-red sword arc at the demon.
But that wasn’t all. She moved in five different directions and unleashed the same attack five more times, causing six arcs to rain on the demon.
He managed to defend against four. However, the last two landed on his body, cutting wounds into his chest and arm.
He lifted his arm, looking at the wounds for a few seconds before his eyes widened. He even staggered back, distancing himself from Velyra.
"You... you absorbed the Bloodheart stone?" he asked as if trying to figure something out. However, Velyra became puzzled.
"What nonsense are you talking about? Why would I absorb a treasure that belongs to my race?" Velyra asked. The demon shook his head.
"...No. How do you explain the fact that I am not healing from the wounds you caused? Only those from your race who have awakened their true bloodline can do that."
He tried to slip into a shadow and make a run for it, but he couldn’t, which dumped another shock on him. The shadow channel was not responding to him.
Velyra was puzzled for a moment before a smile appeared on her lips.
"You can’t run because the entire space is locked, and for my bloodline, you will meet the one who helped me awaken it soon enough. For now, you must suffer for what you did to my tribe."
Velyra unleashed another Blood Cut, thus beginning the nightmare for the shadow demon whom the demon king sent to retrieve the treasure that holds the future of the demon race...

chapters.title: Chapter 594: Scary Abilities
paragraphs: "Should we stop her?" Selene asked, looking in the direction where Velyra and the demon were battling.

"Nope. Let her continue. I mean, it doesn’t look like the demon will be dying anytime soon," Vari said, a smile on her lips. "She is healing the demon and hurting him at the same time. Even if we allow them to fight for the next two weeks, he will never die."
The ladies couldn’t argue with that.
The battle had been going on for the past five hours, but within those five hours, the demon never even came close to hurting Velyra.
It was like when the shadows had been sealed, he lost his ability to fight back. But as a demon of his status, that should not be a factor in his inability to fight back.
He was a Core Formation expert who had completed six core evolutions. If anything, he should be dominating Velyra by now.
However, pitifully lying on the ground and now struggling to get back up was the demon whose state had become one of being tied up and asking an entire tribe to flog him.
His shirt was drenched purple due to his blood spilling every time Velyra attacked.

His body was littered with wounds, making him look even more pitiful than he should have been. Had the eight ladies ganged up on him like Vexthra wanted them to, perhaps he would have lost his mind by now.
Of course, while Velyra was dominating him using her abilities, part of the reason Velyra was having that much dominance was the demon’s fear when he found out he wasn’t healing as he should.
This trait was only awakened in Bloodvein or any blood type race that had awakened their true bloodline. Attacks from them that involve blood cannot be healed easily.
This gave Velyra the answer she needed when she saw the fear in the demon’s eye.
Her new race, the Hemalune bloodline, was something even demons with greater regeneration abilities feared.
So she was dominating him, hurting him in more places than he could survive, and this was thanks to her ability to heal anyone bleeding.
This allowed her to heal the demon and then hurt him, repeating the process over and over again.
If the demon is bleeding, she could use the same blood to heal him.
This made her the perfect torture artist. She could torture a person for all eternity simply because, with her abilities, she could keep them alive for who knows how long.
Fifteen hours later, the demon was still not dead, but Velyra also wasn’t done with her attacks.
In fact, the battle only grew more chaotic as she vented all her pain, imbuing it into her attacks and raining it down on the pitiful demon.
"I am not sympathetic to such a demon, but I think we should stop her. I mean, dying is one thing, but not dying yet enduring this much pain—it might affect his brain.

And we don’t want that. Kent needs him to speak and be able to recall things. If he gets amnesia from this torture, I say it will be a waste," Ingrid said, but her sisters, especially Elaine, Lani, and Neomi, smirked.
"I say we give her another ten hours. That will be enough for the pain she felt when he discovered her family and people were poisoned and had less than a decade to live.
Letting her vent will help her break free of her inner demons before it’s too late," Lani said, and Elaine continued.

"Even if Velyra overdoes it and he dies, I can bring him back. My control over death is strong enough to get him back if his soul hasn’t crossed over to the other side. And that usually takes fifteen minutes to happen.
But for his memories, even if he loses them, Zaila can fix it. So, say the only thing keeping Velyra from killing him is so Kent can do it himself."
Ingrid, who tried to reason with her sisters, was left bewildered. It was like looking at a bunch of crazy bitches who would torture anyone for their man.
Even the innocent Elaine was not innocent anymore. She had become much more evil like her sisters. Ingrid could only shake her head and sigh.
’I pity those who would cross these crazy bitches in the future.’
Thus, Velyra spent another ten hours torturing the demon whose mind had started to give way to the darkness, but Velyra’s healing abilities wouldn’t allow him to fall.
After spending more than a day torturing the bastard, she finally stopped and let Alina take over.
"Hope that felt good," Alina said, and Velyra nodded.
"But I will feel better when I get my hands on the one truly behind it," she said, making Alina nod. It was plain the demon wasn’t truly the only one behind the damage that befell her tribe.
But since he got his hands on this one, she had to torture him to some extent, then she would ensure that the next time she got her hands on the main target, their blood would become their own enemy.
Alina wrote some runes in the air, causing a cage to appear around the demon, trapping him for now. Once she was done, her sisters appeared beside them.
"Looks like you did a number on him, Velyra," Vari said, and the redskin beauty nodded.
"Feels good to vent my frustration."
They ensured she was alright, and then they turned to the demon.

"We are not going to question you or anything. Just know that your nightmare is not over yet. Once our man is done with his training, you will do well to answer his questions, or more pain will follow," Lani said to the demon lying on the ground, panting, barely keeping his eyes open.
The ladies reported to Vexthra, who was keeping Kent company while the rest of her sisters worked on their skills.
Though the skills are theirs, they knew practice would make them even better at using them.
"Keep him there. Kent will wake up soon. So, for now, make sure he doesn’t die," Vexthra said to her sisters before going back to cleaning the sweat off Kent’s forehead.
He had already been in the enlightenment stage for two months, so she knew he would awaken soon.
Two weeks later, Kent opened his eyes, and a powerful sword qi and intent burst out of his body, cleaving the very ground he sat on and filling the air.
Vexthra sat beside him, feeling no discomfort. Instead, she held a smile on her face.
"Congratulations on reaching the Profound stage in both sword qi and sword intent."

chapters.title: Chapter 595: Getting some answers [Bonus]
paragraphs: Kent nodded with a smile, hearing Vexthra’s words. He had indeed reached the Profound stage in both sword qi and sword intent.
This raised his comprehension of the sword to a whole different level.
"It’s all thanks to the push I got from your true name awakening," Kent said, taking Vexthra’s hand. He pulled her closer to himself and kissed her.
"How are you feeling?" Kent asked, and Vexthra smiled.
"I am more than fine. A lot has happened to me that I have yet to come to terms with."

Kent smiled, watching the happiness on her face. He kissed her forehead before walking toward the bathroom. When he was at the entrance, he turned and looked at Vexthra, who blushed and ran after him.
They bathed and spent some quality time together before walking out. Kent didn’t want to say it, but he was happy he had finally gotten the true name awakening out of the way.
Now, they can focus on the next plan, which is to awaken their primordial spirits while he works on his three paths, too.
While bathing, he discovered Vexthra had already formed her own Dao, the Dao of Hatred and Resentment. This means she is now in control of everything related to her divinity.
Before her awakening, she was just a god who inherited the Dao of Hatred and Resentment when she chose to awaken that divinity.
This made her someone akin to a worker for the Dao. However, her divinity has now transformed and has become her own.

Though inheriting the Dao is not bad, having your own is better. So she is happy. This also means that at any point, if she wanted, she could take the path of Dao and undergo the tribulations to become a God King, Emperor, Monarch, and Lord.
Then, eventually, she will undergo the Supreme Tribulation and become a Supreme. All this was supposed to happen step by step during the Path of Dao.
However, now that she has her own Dao, she can invoke tribulation and progress at will until she is ready to become a Supreme.
However, Kent told her to relax and walk the Ancient path too. This time, she will start from the Tier 1 stage, like Zaila has begun doing.
It will take some time for her Primordial spirit to rise back to the god stage, but there is no doubt in what Kent said.
If she indeed manages to walk both paths, she wouldn’t only become a force many will run from, but she would also become one of a kind.
After they finished bathing, Kent took her back to the room and played with little Vexthra for a few hours before they met her sisters, who were still inside the Dead Region with the demon.
"Looks like you ladies did a number on him." After sharing kisses with his women, Kent finally said, walking toward the demon still caged under Alina’s formation.
Hearing Kent’s words, his wives smiled and pointed at Velyra.
"This was all Velyra’s doing," Lani said.
Kent shook his head, looking at the flustered Velyra, who was fidgeting with her fingers. He changed his direction and walked close to her and held her hand.
"No need to look flustered, Velyra, you just vented your frustration on the one who nearly destroyed your race. Now, let me handle the rest."
The redskin beauty nodded.
Kent moved closer to the cage and gestured for Alina to lower it. Once the cage fell, Kent smiled, making the demon break into a cold sweat when he saw it.
"Here is what is going to happen to you. First, I will ask you a series of questions, and you will answer them truthfully. Any attempt to lie, and I will cut a body part off.
Second, you have a chance to save your skin in the end. But that will depend on your answers, so I entreat you to answer me truthfully.

Trust me, I will know if you lie, and you wouldn’t like the first punishment for lying to me. Also, the cutting of body parts isn’t the worst I can do to you," Kent smiled slightly before raising a finger.
"What is your name?" It was a basic question, but he asked anyway.
"I am Shax Homet." The demon responded, not daring to even think before answering. Looking at the lineup behind Kent, he knew lying would be foolish.
In fact, he knew lying would be the end of him. Looking into Kent’s eyes, he could tell the brat was even more dangerous than the redskin beauty who had destroyed him.
And he was right to think in that direction. Kent had indeed become dangerous, and this was due to his having memories of his life until he was a True God.
Though they were made-up memories, their effect on his mindset made him much more dangerous. Shax was scared of him, so he just wanted to get through the questions faster.
"Second question," Kent raised two fingers. "What role do you have in the demon continent? In other words, what is your status among the demons?"
"I am a Demon general of the Shadow Demon State," Shax answered.
"Oh, I see. Then, how many demon states are in the demon empire?"
"Seven states. There is the Shadow Demon State, Fire Demon State, Ice Demon State, Incubus State, Succubus State, Blood Demon State, and the Dark Elves."

"Good. Looks like you understood the trend." Kent smiled. "Now, which among the six are you working for? I know the Shadow Demons don’t need the Blood Heart stone for anything, but I can’t speak for the others."
"I am working for six demon states. In return, they will help me become the next shadow demon king."
Kent burst into resounding laughter, hearing his reply.
It is indeed hilarious. To think a demon would be that dumb and trusting. Just where is the cleverness of the demons when she was forming a contract to betray his own race?
"The Blood Demon race isn’t the only one looking forward to this; the Fire, Ice, Incubus, and Dark Elves are part of this alliance."
Shax’s follow-up answer made Kent shake his head
"Well, I will be damned. It looks like you losers truly wanted the Blood Heart stone. This makes me wonder what the Blood Heart stone can do for your race.
Care to enlighten me?"
This time, Shax hesitated, but looking at the crazy eyes staring at him, he swallowed his saliva and spoke.
"We want it to unseal the Dark Region..."

chapters.title: Chapter 596: The Ancient Race [Bonus]
paragraphs: Hearing Shax’s answer didn’t exactly shock Kent. He expected something like that, considering he was after such a powerful treasure.
However, he wondered about something that made him question many things he had been made aware of about the Dark Region.
’Unseal the Dark Region.’
But Vexthra once told him he had to send Li Hua there when she turned 16. That is in two years’ time. So if that was the case, then what happens to the place being sealed?
’Maybe she wasn’t aware it had been sealed. After all, it has been millions of years already since she ascended, so it is normal.’
But then one more question remained: Why was the place sealed?
That was a haunting question whenever somebody said they were trying to unseal a domain that had been sealed for a long time. Nothing good comes from that.
However, many go through thick and thin just to get something that has been sealed thousands, perhaps millions, of years ago to be unsealed. In the end, great calamity will befall everyone.

However, Kent wanted to do the same thing this time, mainly because he wanted to know what happened during the Ancient Battle of Parting and understand what went wrong that caused Elaine’s family to decline.
The Dark Region holds the answers...or so he thought.
"The Dark Region..." Kent asked thoughtfully, "Why do you want to unseal it?"

Shax wanted to lie or perhaps not say anything, simply because even the little he knew was enough to be considered enough to destroy their plans. However, when Kent smiled, he wiped his mind of the thought of lying.
"We want to open the Dark Region to release the ancient race," Shax said unwillingly. Of course, he had no choice in the matter to begin with.
If he dies, Elaine will bring him back.
But even if she can’t do that, Kent would just take his memories. So, hearing there was a chance to save his skin, he had to speak else—
"Go on, what else?" Kent asked. "I want to know the plan of this ancient race and hear about them too."
Shax sighed.
"The ancient race was the most powerful race before the Parting. However, not many knew of them. Of course, our ancestors did, and that was when we became aware.
We recently discovered that they are hidden within the Dark Region, and it was due to a seal that had been activated for 25 thousand years already.
At first, we didn’t know their race, but we know they are the natural enemies of the Sea race.

I don’t know if you are aware, but the Sea people are the only race in this world that has multiple means to ascend out of this world without having to use the heavenly tribulation, which is nearly impossible to pass.
They have Ascension platforms. Of course, the dwarves, elves, and dwarves do too, but they each have one.

But since we demons don’t have one, we want to negotiate nicely with the sea race to allow us to use just one of their Ascension platforms. However, they reply with hostility, and because we are weak against them, we have to go to this extreme.
Since we discovered that the ancient race was a natural enemy of the sea race, we wanted to unseal and ask for their help to get what we wanted.
"Wait, an alliance of five demon states is afraid of a single race? Why, are you guys children?" Kent chuckled, but his remark made Shax grit his teeth.
Kent’s arrogance made him angry.
"You might not be aware since you live in a backwater continent, but one person from the Sea race can wipe out your entire four kingdoms in under an hour.

While you may seem arrogant, why don’t you travel to the other continents and experience real cultivation? Or do you think having some success in the ancient battlefield of parting makes you the strongest in the world?
Let me tell you, had it not been for the shadows getting locked, I would have killed every single one of these ladies."
"Oh... girls, we have a feisty one on our hands," Kent laughed, and his wives weren’t far behind. They looked amused, hearing such a brag.
Of course, he was right to call the human continent a backwater continent. Humans are truly pitiful since the only race that made them powerful was Elaine’s family.
But after the curse, as they declined, so did the humans. So the humans are indeed a bunch of weak cultivators. But the same cannot be said of the other five races.
But hearing that the sixth, hidden under the sea, is that strong, Kent’s blood was rather boiling at the thought of clashing with them.
"First of all, you are right to call humans weak. They are indeed weak. But looking down on me and my women, trust me, if I want, I can match your demon state and bring it to its knees.
However, I am a pacifist, so I hate slaughter. But that doesn’t mean I am not interested in discovering how strong the Sea race is. However, they can wait.
Now, tell me more about the seal."
Kent knows the two ways to ascend to a high world.
The first is using the tribulation, which will open a door to enter a higher world after you pass. The second is the ascension platforms.
They are like teleportation devices that send one to a higher world connected to the platform.
However, after the Ancient Battle of Parting, this platform went extinct. Of course, the Dragons have one, and so do the elves and dwarves.
However, they don’t allow the other races, mainly the demons and Beastkin, to use it. The beasts are much more powerful, so they prefer tribulation despite the grim success rate.
As for the demons who don’t want to risk it, they sought access to one of the many ascension platforms the Sea people have.
It’s too bad they weren’t allowed to enter their domain and were even slaughtered. Now, they want to take extreme measures, and perhaps they will gain something from it.
The only questions now are: What is this seal? Also, who mounted this seal, and most importantly, why? Kent wants answers to all this, and he knew Shax had those answers.
Kent observes Shax going through many internal struggles, and he can only smile and wait. After spending a few minutes battling his inner demons, he finally speaks.
"The seal is something mounted by the then Patriarch of the Wynthrall family... It was the curse he placed on his people before ascending..."

chapters.title: Chapter 597: Source of The Curse
paragraphs: Kent paid close attention to Shax’s soul, but he couldn’t believe what he had just heard, even after confirming she wasn’t lying.

’...This doesn’t make any sense. I mean, didn’t Elaine’s father say the curse was something that came from the Dark Region? Then why in the hell would Shax say the curse came from the patriarch of the Wynthrall family?’
Kent turned and looked at Elaine. She wore an expression that showed she was in shock and disbelief.
’This doesn’t make sense at all.’ Kent wasn’t accepting this explanation. Yet, in a twisted kind of way, it made sense.
It was like he, in an unusual way, suspected something like this.
But that just doesn’t make any sense. How can a whole patriarch curse his own bloodline and then ascend, leaving them to wither in despair, knowing they will never rise to their former glory again?
’...I will probably have a sit-down with this patriarch if our paths cross one of these days. I mean, what kind of twisted psycho does that?’
"Tell me more about what you know..." Kent said. "Scratch that, tell me everything you know, and please, I don’t want to know about your sex life, so be mindful of what you say."
Shax, who knew he had nothing more to lose, sighed and decided to speak.
"Before the Battle of Parting, the human race was one of the strongest in the world. It had many powerhouses, most of whom came from the Wynthrall family.
However, while it looked like everything was peaceful on the surface, something sinister was happening beneath it.
The ancient race, which is what we call it now, was actually known as Vampires back then and was at war with the Wynthrall family.
The reason behind this hidden war was the blood of the Wynthrall family. From what I know, it contains some unique qualities that make the vampires like it.
However, the Wynthrall family was not easy, so they fought back. However, during the Battle of Parting, something happened that forced the Wynthrall family head to make a bold and sinister choice.
From what I know, he picked the best and brightest of his family and sent them away just when the Parting happened.
They transcended to a high world, and then he used the blood of those still here to seal the Dark Region forever, putting the vampires in an eternal sleep.
So, basically, he made the bold choice to save his best and brightest and sacrifice the ones he deemed a waste. However, this wasn’t just a decision he made because he wanted to seal the vampires.
According to the accounts of those who witnessed this battle, the curse was a sacrifice in which the potential of those left behind in the Wynthrall was given to those who ascended.
It was more sinister, ultimately dooming the human race. But that is not what we are interested in, considering that aside from the Wynthrall, the vampires are also obsessed with the sea race."
"And why is that?"

"Because during the reign of the Wynthrall family of the human race, they shared a good relationship with the sea race. This relationship led to many hybrids being born; I know the vampires want these hybrids.

Our end game was to get the ascension platforms; the rest could take care of itself. Regardless of how things ended between the vampires and the sea people, that is none of our business. We only want one Ascension platform."
And just like that, everything made sense to Kent.

The seal was actually the curse that suppressed the Wynthrall family bloodline, and shockingly, the one who cast the spell was the patriarch of the Wynthrall family. That is the next level of crazy twist.

But that also made some sense. In a way, Kent understood why he had to do that. But the question was, why didn’t he send everyone from his family away and let the other race, like the Dragons or Elves, handle the mess?
The answer, however, was that the patriarch didn’t just divide his family; he took the potential of the ones he was leaving behind and gave it to those he deemed family geniuses.

That is akin to looking in the face of those he was leaving behind and sticking his middle finger up their asses. That was really evil, and Kent didn’t know if it was the air that was growing hot or something else.
"Calm down, Elaine. You will get your revenge on that scum of a family head one day," Vexthra, who knew the source of the heat, said.
Elaine has an affinity for abyssal energy, so she directly affects the air when her emotions stir. Not that she was prohibited from feeling angry. The bastard truly deserves to be killed.
"Don’t worry, my love, I will hunt him down for you. Even if he becomes a god, I will make sure he regrets his decision," Kent said, holding Elaine’s hands.
Shax, who understood what was happening, was in a state of shock. It felt bizarre to him that a descendant of a powerful race that had once lived in this world was right before him.
’So a Wynthrall still walks this world. The vampires would most certainly hunt her down,’ Shax said in his mind.
’...if the Dark Elves don’t first.’

Kent turned and looked at the demon with an amused expression, almost as if he knew what he was thinking. However, he said nothing and instead focused on the thought that a patriarch had cursed his family.
Yet, knowing all this, Kent knew there was more to it than simply knowing that the patriarch of one powerful family had doomed half his family.
He could tell there were some hidden details that he couldn’t place his finger on. The first thought to get his answers was to visit the Sea Race.
Since they house hybrids produced from the union of the Sea Race and the Wynthralls, the best place to learn what really happened is there.
"You have been useful, Shax, but I am not done with you, so why don’t we continue our conversation somewhere else?" Kent paused and looked at Velyra.
"That is, if you don’t mind, my love."
Velyra smiled and shook her head, saying, "If he is helpful to you, then take him away. I have already gotten what I wanted out of the way."
She indeed got what she wanted out of the way. It took over a day, but she let out her frustration.
"In that case, see you ladies later." Kent took Shax and sent him directly to the legion tower, where his undead legion, the Eternal Wrath legion, and Veydris were training.
It was like Kent took Shax from a frying pan into hot, burning lava.

Not that she was prohibited from feeling angry.
The bastard truly deserves to be killed.
"Don’t worry, my love, I will hunt him down for you.
Even if he becomes a god, I will make sure he regrets his decision," Kent said, holding Elaine’s hands.
Shax, who understood what was happening, was in a state of shock.
It felt bizarre to him that a descendant of a powerful race that had once lived in this world was right before him.
’So a Wynthrall still walks this world.
The vampires would most certainly hunt her down,’ Shax said in his mind.
’...if the Dark Elves don’t first.’
Kent turned and looked at the demon with an amused expression, almost as if he knew what he was thinking.
However, he said nothing and instead focused on the thought that a patriarch had cursed his family.
Yet, knowing all this, Kent knew there was more to it than simply knowing that the patriarch of one powerful family had doomed half his family.
He could tell there were some hidden details that he couldn’t place his finger on.
The first thought to get his answers was to visit the Sea Race.
Since they house hybrids produced from the union of the Sea Race and the Wynthralls, the best place to learn what really happened is there.
"You have been useful, Shax, but I am not done with you, so why don’t we continue our conversation somewhere else?" Kent paused and looked at Velyra.
"That is, if you don’t mind, my love."
Velyra smiled and shook her head, saying, "If he is helpful to you, then take him away.
I have already gotten what I wanted out of the way."
She indeed got what she wanted out of the way.
It took over a day, but she let out her frustration.
"In that case, see you ladies later." Kent took Shax and sent him directly to the legion tower, where his undead legion, the Eternal Wrath legion, and Veydris were training.
It was like Kent took Shax from a frying pan into hot, burning lava.

chapters.title: Chapter 598: Learning About The Other Continent
paragraphs: "Master, is he a new addition to the legion?" Kaizo was the first to approach Kent when he arrived in the Legion Tower. The others weren’t far behind.
"I don’t know, Kaizo, but if he proves himself useful, he might get the chance to join the legion one day," Kent said, making Shax turn and look around him.
Sylara was there, and she wasn’t the only one creating an intimidating atmosphere for Shax. All the legions were standing around, excluding Veydris and Irina, who were training inside the void.
The lineup caused Shax to break into a cold sweat. However, Kent just smiled and waved his legion away.
"I want to have a chat with Shax here, so give us the room." The modded and left, leaving him and Shax, who was visibly shocked.

"I know what you are thinking. What would have happened if I had lied or perhaps tried to fight back? The answer is simple: you would lose badly, of course. That would be too bad for you, but I doubt you care about that more than your life, so let’s have a nice chat, shall we?"
Shax nodded like an obedient child. Kent just smiled and sat down.
"First question: How strong is the Sea Race?" Kent knew Shax wouldn’t know much, but he also knew that for someone privy to details of what happened 25 thousand years ago, he was no simple person.
To him, Shax is rotten, but he is an asset...

"I don’t know their inner strength, but from what I saw when we tried to have a talk with them, I say they are powerful. Back then, the Fire, Ice, Blood, Incubus, Succubus, and the Dark Elves sent two people from each state to go to the Sea Race for a talk...

My king sent me to spy on them, not knowing I was part of them. But from what I saw, just one of the sea race people killed all 12 envoys sent. They all died within minutes, and while I am not certain, I can say the killer was a sea dragon.
However, some rumors say the Sea Race has three guards, and even one of them was the Leviathan that roams the depths of the sea.
But I am not certain. However, if the first guard, the sea dragon, could kill some of the powerful demons from the six states, then you get the picture."
Kent couldn’t deny that if the rumors, as Shax says, were true, then he wasn’t ready to face this race. However, he also knew he had to go there one of these days.
As to how he will do that will depend on his moves in the coming months.
"Since you don’t know much, then why don’t we focus on the rest? Among the Dragons, Beasts, Elves, Demons, and Dwarves, which is the strongest?"
"I can’t say for sure, but the Beasts, Dragons, and Elves can contend when it comes to the strength of their leaders. The Elf Queen is terrifying, and so is the Dragon Emperor.
I’ve never seen Lord Qilin of the Beast in action before, but I heard he defeated the leader of a secret organization called the Hand, even taking away her cultivation base.
She regressed to three cores instead of seven, so he is also powerful. But that is all I can say, taking the leaders into account.
However, when it comes to hidden power, I will give it to the Beasts; they have many experts and a powerful new generation of geniuses."
Shax was much more accepting, considering he was screwed if he made any stupid moves. The location he was in made him aware that the brat before him was like a god looking down at him.
So he was giving more context than required, which is helpful to Kent...
Kent just nodded, knowing he had indeed found a good asset to learn more about the outside world from.
"And when you say hidden power, are you talking in the sense of Ancestors of the race or what?" Kent asked.

"Something like that. But they are not the only ones. Most of their experts are in the ancient battlefield of Parting, so you won’t notice them. But when they are called back, you will know how powerful these races are.
Even we demons have many experts hidden away, waiting for a danger to come before they emerge."
"Intriguing. Looks like the outside world is much more fun than this human continent." Kent smiled, already planning his moves.
"You mentioned Dragon Emperor. How many species of dragons are under him?" Kent asked.
"Three species. There are the Crystal Dragons, the Flame Dragons, and the Earth Dragons. The Crystal Dragons are the strongest, but the other two are no pushovers either."
Kent nodded.
"How about the Elves? I learned the High Elves are no more." Shax nodded to his words, making Kent smile. He had met a High Elf before when he reviewed Jest’s memories.
Although dragons are arrogant, the High Elves are the worst kind of arrogant. They are annoying, too, so it’s good that they are no more.
"The last of them ascended long ago. However, the Half-elves are still around and have their own kingdom. Though they are under the elves, so we consider them one."
"How about the one called the Pill Princess?" Kent asked yet another question, but this time, Shax widened his eyes.
"What, is it forbidden to talk about her?" Kent asked, noticing Shax’s expression...
"No. I am just shocked you know of her. Looks like her influence has also reached this far." A smile appeared on his face.
It was not a perverted one; it was more like a proud smile, which looks bizarre considering he is a demon.
This deepened Kent’s interest in knowing this Pill Princess.
"Well, what about her? Is she like some national treasure that even you demons had to cherish and praise?"
"Something like that. She is the only disciple of the one and only Pill Emperor in the entire world.
Everybody respects her not because she is the princess of the Elven race, but because she is the disciple of a Pill Emperor and also a brilliant Pill Saint who can craft 100% pure pills up to Tier 8.
And in case you don’t know, Tier 8 is higher than the stage a Pill Saint can handle.
She hadn’t upgraded her ranking to become a Pill Sage mainly because she wanted to have seven enlightenments in the Pill Path before becoming a Pill Sage.
She had already completed five.

Recently, I learned she even concocted a Tier 9 pure pill, showing how amazing she is. But aside from her clearly impressive feats in alchemy, she is also a core formation expert and has already completed six core evolutions," Shax said with a smile.
"It looks like she is impressive," Kent smiled. "How do I get close to her and challenge her to a duel?"
"Errh?" Shax’s jaw was left hanging...

chapters.title: Chapter 599: Impossible to Get To...
paragraphs: Although Shax was not in a favorable territory, he couldn’t help but laugh when he heard Kent’s bold words. It was like hearing the most unbelievable thing ever.

Getting to the Pill Princess and challenging her to a duel was just too arrogant from Shax’s perspective. It was like hearing Kent say he was going to storm the Dragon Empire and dethrone the Dragon Emperor by telling him to stand up and let him have his throne.
The audacity in Kent’s words made Shax unsure whether to be indefinitely amused or angry at the arrogant human before him.
In the end, he just shook his head.

"She is impossible to get to, so forget your ideas about challenging her. Even if you are the best in the human continent when it comes to pill making, you will be a child before her... that would be bullying, and I don’t think she would want that."
Kent was dumbfounded, hearing this.

"Clearly, you are exaggerating. She is the princess of the Elven Empire. I doubt she will be hard to get to." Kent wasn’t sure where Shax’s thoughts came from, but he knew he was exaggerating when he said the Pill Princess couldn’t be approached.
If anything, it should be more like getting to her will be much more difficult, but not impossible. However, saying she is impossible to approach was just too much.
Even he was sure the Supreme Celestial, whom Vexthra said was the ruler of the entire universe, could be approached in some way.
So a normal elven princess shouldn’t be hard to get to...
"I say she is impossible to get to because even her family can’t easily see her, and that is the Elven Queen I am talking about. Getting to her own daughter is not easy."
Kent just continued to stare at Shax as he spoke, making him wonder many things. Thankfully, Shax knew when to let out more information, so he let him speak.

"The reason you can’t get to the Pill Princess is because she is not in the Elven Empire. She is in the most powerful place in the entire world—the Supreme Immortal Sect, the number one sect in the entire world."
"This means you can’t get to her since you are not a disciple there. And don’t even ask me how to become a disciple. You can’t get in, so forget all ideas of getting to the Pill Princess."
"Supreme Immortal Sect—that is a fancy name for a sect in this medium world," Kent smiled. Just hearing the name was enough for him to start planning...

Before he can become a Pill Saint, he must defeat the Pill Princess in a duel. Now, he was just learning that getting to her was impossible simply because she was in the most secure, powerful, and perhaps the only place in the world that was hard to get to...
"There is no place in this world that I, Kent Madson, can’t get to..." Kent bragged, making Shax shake his head. However, a few seconds into his amused expression, his eyes widened.
"You... are Kent Madson." Up until now, he had never heard Kent’s name, so he didn’t even know the person who was messing with him. But now he did, and the revelation shocked him.
"Why, is my name taboo in your race?" Kent couldn’t help asking, watching the shocked expression on Shax’s face.

"No. But you are the most wanted person in the entire world. I don’t know what you did to The Hand, or whether the rumors about you are true, but they spread the word that you are in possession of someone having an Atomic Divine Body.
And in case you are not aware, someone with an atomic divine body is like the greatest treasure anyone would chase after."
"This news made everyone want to get their hands on you, and they even said you have more wealth than a kingdom."
"You shouldn’t step on any of the continents if you don’t want to die, and you should certainly never try to cross the Black Sea. Trust me, you don’t want that."
Kent didn’t know what to say to this, so he just smiled.
’Looks like my warning to The Hand pissed them off so much that they are using all their efforts to ensure I don’t see the light of day.’ His smile bloomed, showing no sign of fear.
’Oh, I most certainly will enjoy destroying that organization.’
"I see. Thank you for telling me, but I will come soon enough and use the Black Sea to get there, so I hope they try to stop me... I most certainly am going to enjoy killing them."
Shax remained quiet, not even wanting to think too much about the events that would happen when Kent showed his face on the other continents. That was something he didn’t want to think about.
"So you are saying you don’t know how to get into this Supreme Immortal Sect, right?" Kent asked, and Shax sighed.
"Only the best of the best in the world can get in. Of course, your human empire has not been part of the selections since the humans declined long ago..
But if you want to get in, then find a way to integrate into the other races and show the world your prowess, and perhaps that will be your way in."
Kent nodded.
He went on to ask more questions. When he was done, he decided not to kill Shax but to make him his informant.
Of course, he didn’t add him to the Legion Tower. He added him to the Servant Tower and made Elaine heal him.

His target was the Blood Demon King, who created the spell that caused the Bloodvein tribe to migrate. Of course, he would destroy the spell soon enough, but he first wants to send a message to the creator.

That would also be Shax’s way of keeping his head on his body. If he does as he was told, he might get more information from this demon alliance and perhaps even gain more insight into how they want to destroy the seal.
After all, Shax said, there are two methods, but the other method is tough to manage. But now, they might try that considering their first method was a no-go...
He wants to know all their plans, and Shax will get all that information.

Shax promised to gather what he could on the shadow demons and the other demon states. Kent needed all this because once he came out of seclusion, he would start working toward his end goals in this world.
One of them was to become a Pill Saint and perhaps a Pill Sage... maybe even a Pill King before ascending to a higher world.
He must prove himself to the world and show how best to do that if he does not dominate everywhere.
He sent him away after ensuring he was prepared for his undercover mission. Kent ensured he had what he needed to gather more information on the demons and even the elves.
He couldn’t do that in the Dragon Empire because they wouldn’t even allow him access to their lands. But he could enter the Elven Empire since he had connections there.
After Shax left, Kent went to see how the Bloodvein tribe was faring; however, on his way, a sudden quest made him turn and move back to the Harem Tower...

chapters.title: Chapter 600: Poison Revenge (1)
paragraphs: The Kyrrith Kingdom is known as the strongest kingdom on the human continent. It is surrounded by mountain ranges and rich in minerals.
However, what makes them the strongest is their craft.
They are the best at weapon making and thus the strongest in combat. Thankfully, the king of the Kyrrith Kingdom ensures the warriors are well equipped despite no war coming to them anytime soon.
Nobody can remember the last time the four kingdoms were at war.
They don’t, simply because every kingdom has something to offer, and going to war means they won’t supply what they offer to you, regardless of how powerful you are.
Even if one kingdom manages to take over another, that will only end in mass bloodshed, which the four kingdoms agreed not to let happen.
So, for a kingdom such as Kyrrith to be equipping its soldiers with weapons means only one thing: they are afraid of something or someone.
It was as if they had been preparing for the past 200 years for something or someone.
And as it turns out, it was someone... someone who made an entire kingdom weary.
Three hundred years ago, the Deckling Noble family ruled Kyrrith. They were a family of alchemists, and under their reign, Kyrrith was known as one of the biggest places for cheaper pills.
They made sure alchemy was the main focus of Kyrrith, and the people loved them for it. However, 200 years ago, the Deckling family woke up to a slaughter that soon consumed the entire household.
Every last one, from the young to the adult, was slaughtered, and the perpetrators were actually two merchant families that joined hands through marriage.
Every last Deckling was slaughtered—except one who managed to escape thanks to his mother. However, through the escape process, she was poisoned.
But she didn’t die. She was an alchemist, so she stayed alive to plot her revenge. This survivor was later known as one of the Seven Pill Saints.
She was known everywhere as the Wicked Poison Witch, who didn’t care about anyone’s feelings and could kill as long as she set her mind to it.
Naturally, that was just an act to remain hidden and closer to the Vale noble family who employed her poison-making skills.
They asked for her help many times, unaware that the one they’d been preparing for was right in front of them.

But it wasn’t like anyone would have seen through her disguise. Despite having become a Peak Ascendent and a Pill Saint who could harness poison to some degree, she never sought revenge simply because her true power was suppressed when she was poisoned.

However, when Kent cured her, the real Poison Witch awakened her powers and even advanced to the 3rd stage in core formation. It turned out that suppressing her cultivation all these past years was a blessing in disguise.
And now, she had come for revenge.
The sky in Vale City had turned purple, filled with poison. Thousands had already died, and more kept dying while thousands ran frantically, trying to escape.

It was the Poison Witch’s signature move—the one that first creates chaos and then eventually unleashes the main attack. Naturally, nobody wanted to be there when the main attack was unleashed, so they fled.
"What is the Poison Witch doing?" a man in his late 40s asked, standing atop a tall building ten miles away. Behind him were seven individuals, each standing at the peak of the Root Sovereign stage.
It wouldn’t take a genius to know they were the generals of the Kyrrith Kingdom.
"My king, I think we should consider the fact that she is here to attack us, considering her poison is spreading toward us," one of the generals said.
In the past, if the Poison Witch wanted revenge on someone, she had to inform the king beforehand. But today, she just came and started killing.
Of course, King Vale and the generals didn’t notice, but those dying were from the Vale or the Wilson family. This showed she had come to kill a particular group of people today.
The people from the Vale and Wilson bloodline who joined hands and slaughtered her family 200 years ago.

"Pill Saint Riva, I wasn’t made aware you would be conducting an operation here today. Why then are you causing this grave massacre?" King Vale asked, but the Poison Witch didn’t even turn to look at him.
This pissed King Vale off, but he had to swallow his pride before saying something he would regret. He already knew the reputation of the Wicked Poison Witch.
"If this has something to do with a mistake I or anyone in my family made, please, I entreat you to stop so we can negotiate and come to a peaceful ending.

He knew this had something to do with him. Naturally, he felt a chill down his spine when Pill Saint Riva spoke.
"I cannot reverse time," he had to answer.
If he chose not to, more would keep dying, and even as he answered, more were dying. So it was more like he wanted to see if he could calm the situation by responding.
"Since you can’t reverse time, then there is nothing to talk about... Go and gather your two families. Tell them the time has come for them to pay for their crimes."

Pill Saint Riva suddenly changed into her beautiful younger self. King Vale staggered back in the air, feeling his spine freeze when his eyes landed on the beautiful lady standing 200 meters from him.
"Princess Lovina..." His voice turned cold when he said that name.
"It’s time for you to pay for your crimes, House Vale and House Wilson." A staff appeared in her hand, and she waved it.
"Poison Rain." Suddenly, painful cries filled the city as thousands of people started crying blood, some melting under the acid rain falling from the sky...
"Sound the alarms!" one of the Sovereigns behind King Vale shouted as they flew away, holding the king in their arms.

sentences.text: The Kyrrith Kingdom is known as the strongest kingdom on the human continent.
It is surrounded by mountain ranges and rich in minerals.
However, what makes them the strongest is their craft.
They are the best at weapon making and thus the strongest in combat.
Thankfully, the king of the Kyrrith Kingdom ensures the warriors are well equipped despite no war coming to them anytime soon.
Nobody can remember the last time the four kingdoms were at war.
They don’t, simply because every kingdom has something to offer, and going to war means they won’t supply what they offer to you, regardless of how powerful you are.
Even if one kingdom manages to take over another, that will only end in mass bloodshed, which the four kingdoms agreed not to let happen.
So, for a kingdom such as Kyrrith to be equipping its soldiers with weapons means only one thing: they are afraid of something or someone.
It was as if they had been preparing for the past 200 years for something or someone.
And as it turns out, it was someone... someone who made an entire kingdom weary.
Three hundred years ago, the Deckling Noble family ruled Kyrrith.
They were a family of alchemists, and under their reign, Kyrrith was known as one of the biggest places for cheaper pills.
They made sure alchemy was the main focus of Kyrrith, and the people loved them for it.
However, 200 years ago, the Deckling family woke up to a slaughter that soon consumed the entire household.
